jobs.jobDescription:
About 1mind

1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.

We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans, go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.

Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.

About the Role

We’re looking for elite Account Executives who thrive on challenge, own outcomes, and want to be part of something category-defining.

You’ll run the full sales cycle, build pipeline from scratch, and lead conversations with senior executives at some of the most iconic enterprise brands in the world. You’ll evangelize a new way of going to market — AI-led revenue growth — and help us create the playbook for the next generation of GTM.

We have a high bar for excellence and will hire only the best of the best. If you’ve been looking for a place to move fast, think big, and win with purpose — this is it. (P.S. Meet our Superhuman, Mindy, to see 1mind in action.)

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle — from outbound to close to expansion — across mid-market, and enterprise

  • Build and manage pipeline with a focus on executive-level outreach and high-velocity execution

  • Lead strategic discovery and demo calls that tie 1mind directly to measurable business outcomes

  • Partner with GTM leadership to evolve our strategy, messaging, and sales motion

  • Act as a credible thought leader and category evangelist for AI-led growth in the market

  • Founder’s mentality: You act like an owner — proactive, resourceful, resilient and always in service of the customer and the mission

  • Executive presence & evangelism: You command a room, reframe buyer thinking, and tell a story that moves people

  • Consistent overachiever: You’ve crushed quota again and again through precision, speed, and strategic execution

  • Grit & coachability: You’re relentless, curious, and always leveling up. Feedback is fuel

  • Process-obsessed: You’re buttoned up, data-driven, and operate with efficiency and intent

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota

  • Experience selling into GTM, product, or technical leadership — and a strong network with C-level decision makers in B2B SaaS

  • Background in early-stage, high-growth environments where speed and ownership matter

  • Proven outbound muscle — you can build pipeline from zero

  • Deep interest in AI, automation, and the future of work

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • Travel (up to ~30%): This is a hands-on, in-market sales role. While we’re remote-first, being face-to-face with customers is a key lever for growth, and you should expect up to ~30% travel. We’re building something early and ambitious, and that means showing up—on-site, at events, and wherever the opportunity is—to drive pipeline and revenue.

Why Join Us?

  • We’re completely transforming how companies go to market — scaling revenue beyond human capacity

  • Help define a new category and build the GTM engine from the ground up

  • Work alongside a top-tier, high-ownership team during a rapid growth phase

  • High visibility, high impact role — with room to grow as we scale

We’re looking for Superhumans to help us deploy Superhumans. If that’s you, let’s talk.

For this role, the expected base salary range is:

United States: $125,000 – $160,000 USD (plus commission)

Canada: $172,000 CAD - $220,000 CAD (plus commission)

1mind's total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. The hiring manager will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through the process.

We believe in providing interesting and meaningful work in a supportive and inclusive environment - free from discrimination for everyone without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. If you are passionate about learning and excited about what we are doing, then we want to hear from you!

jobs.jobDescription:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring a Engineering Lead to build the systems that help our clinical teams deliver services in the field and in members’ homes. You will own technical direction and delivery for scheduling, dispatch, field and mobile workflows, and the software that connects equipment and home technology to the operation.

A likely first assignment is an “Air Traffic Control” system for field operations. A supervisor needs to understand what is happening and act when the plan breaks: a flat tire, a delayed visit, a missing piece of equipment, or a member whose availability changes. You will work with the people doing the job to decide what they need to see, what the system can help resolve, and when a human should intervene.

This is a hands-on role that spans product and engineering. You will understand the business problem, shape the solution, build useful increments, and see whether they work. You may start without direct reports and can expect to coach and eventually manage one or two engineers. You should enjoy building personally and helping others become more capable.

We value a tinkering instinct: try the unfamiliar tool, inspect the data, trace the failure, put a small improvement in front of a user, and learn from what happens. Hardware or connected-device experience can be a strong signal of that mindset, but it is not required. The central work is building dependable software for an operation that changes throughout the day.

As an Engineering Lead, Clinical Operations, you will:

  • Work directly with supervisors, clinical field staff, and operations leaders to understand schedules, travel, capacity, handoffs, and the exceptions that disrupt a day’s work.
  • Build field visibility and intervention tools that give supervisors useful context, distinguish current facts from missing information, and help them respond to changing conditions.
  • Develop scheduling and dispatch capabilities that match people and visits to practical constraints, with clear ways for operating staff to review and adjust the plan.
  • Build and debug APIs, mobile workflows, integrations, and data flows supporting field teams, connected equipment, and home technology.
  • Prototype quickly and ship focused increments. Make deliberate choices about what to build, integrate, or buy, and avoid committing to a large system before the operation has tested the approach.
  • Use AI actively for development, investigation, prototypes, analysis, and useful workflow capabilities. Check the behavior and make failures understandable and recoverable.
  • Coach engineers and take on a small number of direct reports as the team develops. Maintain clear ownership, sound engineering practices, and credible delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Product, Special Project Leads, IT, Counterpart, and the Engagement lead at the interfaces their work shares with field operations.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand how the field operation works, have shipped an improvement used by supervisors or field staff, and can show what it changed. You have a focused technical plan grounded in real constraints and exceptions.
  • First six months: Several useful increments are in place. Supervisors can understand and respond to disruptions more effectively, scheduling and field workflows are improving, and technical ownership is clear.

You should get in touch if:

  • You are a strong production software engineer who has owned meaningful work end-to-end and still builds regularly.
  • You can move across backend services, APIs, data flows, user interfaces, and operational workflows to solve a real problem.
  • You have strong product instincts, learn unfamiliar domains directly, and enjoy working with the people using what you build.
  • You have an iterative, curious approach to technology. You can describe an unfamiliar system you explored, a practical prototype you tried, or a failure you traced across boundaries.
  • You use AI in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities, with clear verification and evaluation.
  • You can coach engineers and are interested in responsibility for a small team as it develops. Formal management experience can help, but a strong record of Engineering Leadership and coaching also matters.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Nomi Health is rebuilding healthcare with services and technology solutions designed to make access to quality, affordable care simpler and more direct. We connect buyers, providers, and patients through an operating model focused on reducing complexity, improving transparency, and removing unnecessary cost from the healthcare system.

The Impact You’ll Make

We're hiring an early-career Legal Operations and Contracts Specialist to help keep our legal function running smoothly. You'll support the Director of Legal across contract intake, NDAs, contract systems, Deal Desk operations, corporate records, and subpoena response. You'll work with our CEO, COO, and in-house and outside counsel, and you'll get hands-on training and steadily growing responsibility, including first-pass contract review with guidance from counsel.

This is a strong launch point for a career in legal operations, contracts, or in-house legal. If you're curious, organized, and hungry to learn, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Contract Intake, Triage, and Review

  • Help the Director of Legal build and run our contracting process.
  • Triage incoming legal and contracting requests, prioritize them, and route them to the right person. Learn when and to whom to escalate.
  • Own our standard NDA process: requests, execution, and tracking.
  • Learn to perform first-pass redlines on data sharing agreements, non-standard NDAs, and master agreements against our templates and positions, with guidance and review from counsel. Summarize key deviations and open issues.
  • Support agreements for acquiring data from data providers and other vendors.
  • Maintain and periodically review our templates for NDAs, order forms, and other client agreements.

Contract Systems and Repository

  • Serve as day-to-day administrator for Ironclad (workflows, templates, permissions, user support, and migration of legacy contracts). Training is provided.
  • Manage DocuSign envelopes, templates, routing, and tracking to completion.
  • Maintain an organized contract repository covering executed order forms, data sharing agreements, NDAs, go-lives, and terminations.
  • Manage the internal sign-off process and help ensure adherence to company policies.
  • Assist with documenting independent contractors.

Order Forms and Deal Desk

  • Create and maintain standard order forms aligned with current pricing and policy.
  • Manage the Deal Desk inbox, including partner and direct-client requests, new-client processing, and change requests.
  • Create and update accounts, opportunities, and CPQ quotes in Salesforce, and make sure required fields and contract execution dates are accurate.
  • Follow up on outstanding or unsigned order forms.

Audits and Data Quality

  • Perform the weekly Deal Desk audit and recurring monthly Salesforce data-quality audits (lead source and influence source reviews, unknown-account cases, debooking and termination reviews).
  • Support projects to streamline contract databases and account information across our CRM and finance systems.

Policy Process

  • Partner with team members on creating, reviewing, and maintaining internal policies.
  • Assist with review cadence, policy storage, and version control.

Legal and Executive Support

  • Partner with the CEO, COO, and counsel on document production, reviews, and ad hoc requests.
  • Coordinate administrative tasks for contracts under negotiation and help clarify contract terms.
  • Answer internal and external questions about contract terms.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion.

Corporate Filings and Records

  • Maintain corporate filings and records, track entities and filing deadlines, and update entity filings as needed.

Subpoena and Records Request Response

  • Receive and respond to subpoenas and records requests, coordinate with internal teams to locate records, and track every request.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in a legal, paralegal, contracts, compliance, or operations role. Internships, law firm or in-house legal experience, or equivalent experience count.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to stay organized across many concurrent requests.
  • Good judgment and the instinct to ask for help or escalate when something doesn't look right.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build good working relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • Ability to adapt, pivot between priorities, and wear multiple hats.
  • A curious, teachable mindset and a real desire to learn and expand your role.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to NDAs, data sharing or data use agreements, or basic commercial contracts.
  • Familiarity with Ironclad or another CLM platform, DocuSign, or Salesforce (CPQ in particular).
  • Interest in healthcare, data, or SaaS businesses.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent paralegal experience. A paralegal certification is not required.

Why Join Us

  • Hands-on mentorship from the Director of Legal and exposure to our CEO, COO, and outside counsel.
  • Broad exposure across contracts, data licensing, privacy, and corporate governance in healthcare, finance, and technology.
  • A clear path to grow into more responsibility as your skills develop.
  • Fully remote work with a ~250-person company.

Equal Opportunity

Nomi Health is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a workplace where qualified applicants and team members are considered for opportunities without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We're here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We're revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day's work.

The Dashboards team builds the data visualization experiences that help Smartsheet customers turn raw information into clear, executive-ready insight. We're a vibrant team with engineers at every level — from early-career to senior — and we're responsible for the beautiful data visualizations that help our customers make confident, timely executive decisions. We're growing our investment in AI-powered features and modern data infrastructure, and we're looking for an Engineering Manager to help lead the team through this next chapter.

You will lead and grow a team of engineers spanning all experience levels, coaching them to deliver high-quality, beautiful data visualization features on time and with lasting technical health. You'll own the roadmap creation and execution for the Dashboards team, partner closely with Product and cross-functional stakeholders, and help shape how the team builds AI-enabled features on modern data platforms like Databricks.

You will report to Sr Manager, Engineering. This is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered.

You Will:

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers across all experience levels, building a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Own roadmap creation and prioritization for the Dashboards team in partnership with Product and Design, translating customer and business needs into a clear, sequenced plan
  • Drive successful, predictable delivery of projects — from scoping through launch — balancing quality, speed, and technical debt
  • Build and evolve team structure, process, and ways of working (e.g., planning cadence, on-call, sprint/Scrumban process) to match team growth and delivery needs
  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute strategy for AI-powered dashboard and analytics features, including work built on Databricks and modern data infrastructure
  • Interview, hire, and onboard engineers to build a high-performing, diverse team
  • Coach, mentor, and develop direct reports, providing career growth planning, regular feedback, and performance management
  • Create an inclusive team culture that recognizes individual strengths and supports engagement and development for engineers at every level
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to ensure Dashboards work is well-integrated with the broader platform
  • Communicate roadmap, delivery status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and business leadership
  • Other duties as assigned

You Have:

  • 2-3+ years of experience managing medium to large engineering teams
  • A proven track record of successful project delivery, roadmap creation, and team/process building
  • Experience building and shipping AI-powered product features
  • Experience with Databricks or similar modern data platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic, growth-oriented environment, with the ability to adapt and shift priorities to meet evolving needs
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical work into business impact for stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience coaching and developing engineers across a range of experience levels, from early-career to senior/principal

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$175,000—$245,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. jobs.jobDescription:
At NerdWallet, we're building tools and experiences that help people make smarter financial decisions. As a Software Engineer focused on AI & Automation within our Security organization, you'll build production software and AI-enabled systems that make security work more scalable, effective, and developer-friendly across NerdWallet.

You'll apply strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on AI experience to automate complex security workflows, build internal platforms and developer tooling, and help us rethink how security engineering operates in an AI-native environment. You do not need to come from a traditional security engineering background. We're looking for an engineer who has built and operated production software and AI-enabled systems, is curious about security, and is excited to develop deeper security expertise while solving meaningful problems at scale.

You'll have room to bring new ideas, influence how AI and automation practices evolve at NerdWallet, and shape a growing area within Security. This role reports to the Security Automation Manager.

Projects you may be working on in this position include:

  • Designing and building AI-enabled workflows and multi-agent systems that automate security design review, threat modeling, policy Q&A, vulnerability analysis, and other high-value security processes.

  • Building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search experiences across large code and documentation repositories.

  • Creating automated code-review capabilities that help identify insecure patterns and improve software quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

  • Building production Python services and APIs that power AI-enabled security workflows, with thoughtful architecture, authentication, authorization, testing, observability, and reliability.

  • Designing and operating scalable pipelines that ingest, process, index, and retrieve large volumes of code, documents, and events.

  • Improving AI system quality through evaluation frameworks, experiment management, prompt and context management, observability, and evidence-based iteration.

  • Managing practical production tradeoffs such as latency, reliability, model/provider selection, token usage, and cost.

  • Designing integrations with GitHub, Slack, Jira, Confluence, LLM providers, and internal services so security guidance fits naturally into engineering workflows.

  • Applying security controls to AI applications, including prompt injection defenses, sensitive-data handling, access control, supply-chain considerations, and safe model inputs and outputs.

  • Identifying new opportunities for software, automation, and AI augmentation across the Security team and independently moving high-value ideas from problem definition through production.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Own technically meaningful software and AI initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

  • Help shape how AI and automation are used across NerdWallet Security, including when AI is the right solution and when it is not.

  • Build tools and platforms that make security easier for engineering teams to adopt and use.

  • Improve the speed, consistency, and quality of security workflows through thoughtful software design and automation.

  • Grow into deeper application and AI security expertise while bringing strong software engineering judgment to the team.

  • Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate with engineers, security partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

Your experience:

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong Python proficiency, including hands-on experience building production backend services and APIs.

  • Experience designing maintainable backend architectures, including separation of concerns, request/response validation, authentication/authorization, error handling, testing, and observability.

  • Experience developing distributed or cloud-based systems and making practical decisions about scalability, reliability, and performance.

  • Hands-on experience building production AI-enabled applications or automations using LLM APIs, agents/tool use, RAG/retrieval, or comparable architectures.

  • Experience defining, evaluating, and improving the quality of AI-enabled systems in production.

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, identify opportunities independently, and move technical work from idea to implementation.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and limitations clearly.

  • Interest in secure software development and willingness to build deeper expertise in application security and AI security.

Where:

  • This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

  • We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

  • New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

  • Mental health support

  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

  • Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

  • Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

  • Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • 401K with 4% company match

  • Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

  • Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

NerdWallet will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the San Francisco Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice, as well as the Los Angeles Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice.

About 1mind

1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.

We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans, go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.

Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.

About the Role

We’re looking for elite Account Executives who thrive on challenge, own outcomes, and want to be part of something category-defining.

You’ll run the full sales cycle, build pipeline from scratch, and lead conversations with senior executives at some of the most iconic enterprise brands in the world. You’ll evangelize a new way of going to market — AI-led revenue growth — and help us create the playbook for the next generation of GTM.

We have a high bar for excellence and will hire only the best of the best. If you’ve been looking for a place to move fast, think big, and win with purpose — this is it. (P.S. Meet our Superhuman, Mindy, to see 1mind in action.)

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle — from outbound to close to expansion — across mid-market, and enterprise

  • Build and manage pipeline with a focus on executive-level outreach and high-velocity execution

  • Lead strategic discovery and demo calls that tie 1mind directly to measurable business outcomes

  • Partner with GTM leadership to evolve our strategy, messaging, and sales motion

  • Act as a credible thought leader and category evangelist for AI-led growth in the market

  • Founder’s mentality: You act like an owner — proactive, resourceful, resilient and always in service of the customer and the mission

  • Executive presence & evangelism: You command a room, reframe buyer thinking, and tell a story that moves people

  • Consistent overachiever: You’ve crushed quota again and again through precision, speed, and strategic execution

  • Grit & coachability: You’re relentless, curious, and always leveling up. Feedback is fuel

  • Process-obsessed: You’re buttoned up, data-driven, and operate with efficiency and intent

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–7+ years of SaaS sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota

  • Experience selling into GTM, product, or technical leadership — and a strong network with C-level decision makers in B2B SaaS

  • Background in early-stage, high-growth environments where speed and ownership matter

  • Proven outbound muscle — you can build pipeline from zero

  • Deep interest in AI, automation, and the future of work

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • Travel (up to ~30%): This is a hands-on, in-market sales role. While we’re remote-first, being face-to-face with customers is a key lever for growth, and you should expect up to ~30% travel. We’re building something early and ambitious, and that means showing up—on-site, at events, and wherever the opportunity is—to drive pipeline and revenue.

Why Join Us?

  • We’re completely transforming how companies go to market — scaling revenue beyond human capacity

  • Help define a new category and build the GTM engine from the ground up

  • Work alongside a top-tier, high-ownership team during a rapid growth phase

  • High visibility, high impact role — with room to grow as we scale

We’re looking for Superhumans to help us deploy Superhumans. If that’s you, let’s talk.

For this role, the expected base salary range is:

United States: $125,000 – $160,000 USD (plus commission)

Canada: $172,000 CAD - $220,000 CAD (plus commission)

The Payment Integrity team is a group of innovative thinkers sitting at the intersection of Clover's provider Network, Claims, and Tech teams. The Payment Integrity team ensures that Clover pays claims in an accurate manner, with a particular focus on reducing inappropriate medical spend.

As an DRG Validation Auditor at Clover Health, you will play a key role ensuring that Clover is able to continue to build and scale a compliant, efficient and profitable program. You will work to ensure quality assurance standards and regulatory policy are reflected in claims processing practices. You will help drive value for every member by ensuring that Clover’s medical claims are paid accurately and recovering overpayments when they are identified. The Associate - Inpatient Coder coordinates the identification of provider DRG denials and upcoding.

As an DRG Validation Auditor, you will:

  • Partner with Clinical, Claims, and Payment Integrity peers to review claims for DRG related issues on a prospective and retrospective basis that drive inaccurate payments to providers.
  • Proactively identify overpayments to ensure accurate claims payments on inpatient services.
  • Participate in collaborative discussions with MDs to verify the clinical rationale behind billed procedures.
  • Communicate effectively while building trust and lasting partnerships both laterally and vertically across multi-discipline teams.
  • Communicate effectively both internally and externally to ensure accurate claims adjudication and proper provider notification.

Success in this role looks like:

  • By the end of your initial 90-day period, you will have demonstrated a strong understanding of clinical coding practices and medical records review, while assisting our team in areas of DRG validation.
  • By 6 months, you will be working autonomously to execute within our clinical review workflows and will have developed strong interpersonal relationships across the organization.
  • Continued success in this position anchors in on developing a deep understanding of the workflows that support our clinical review life cycle, while maintaining regulatory compliance standards.

You should get in touch if:

  • You hold a CCS or CIC certification; required.
  • Knowledge of DRG pricing methodology; required.
  • You have at least 1 year of direct inpatient clinical coding experience.
  • Medicare or Medicare Advantage payment integrity or claims operations experience; preferred
  • You are technologically savvy with strong computer skills in Excel and PowerPoint.

jobs.jobDescription:
We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.

We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.

What You'll Do:

  • Market solution design. Partner with network, go-to-market, and sales teams to define and scope what Nomi can realistically deliver in each new market before it's sold, including provider coverage, TPA capability, and integration sequencing.
  • Partner and TPA data exchange. Write the integration requirements between Nomi and every partner in the claim lifecycle — inbound claims, priced output, remittance, eligibility, file cadence, SLAs, and reconciliation — specific enough that an engineer on either side can build to it.
  • Network configuration and pricing. Own the path from a signed rate sheet to a correctly priced claim: ingestion, normalization, versioning, effective dating, validation, and audit. Set the testing and release bar for anything that touches pricing.
  • Provider data, adequacy, and directory. Own the provider data model and hierarchy — sponsor, tax ID, billing NPI, service location — and make network adequacy and directory accuracy measurable rather than asserted.
  • New segments and group types. Evaluate new group types and segments as they come up, be willing to recommend against ones that don't fit, and defend that recommendation to sales.
  • The payments interface. Recognize when a network change has payment-side consequences and get ahead of it with the financial services and payments teams before it ships.

What We're Looking For:

  • Reimbursement fluency. You understand the difference between billed, allowed, and paid, and you've worked hands-on with real fee schedules and rate methodologies, percent-of-Medicare, per diem, case rate, DRG, percent-of-charge.
  • Domain background. You've built this expertise at a health plan, a TPA, a repricing or payment-integrity vendor, a reference-based-pricing administrator, a provider revenue-cycle organization, or a network contracting organization.
  • Data exchange experience. You're comfortable with 837, 835, and eligibility file exchange, and you've written integration requirements that another team was able to build from successfully.
  • Commercial confidence. You're comfortable representing Nomi directly in front of a broker, a TPA executive, or a health system, and making commitments you can stand behind.
  • A self-directed approach. You're comfortable defining your own priorities and figuring out what matters most, rather than working off a pre-built roadmap.
  • Enough technical fluency to be credible. You can read a data model, write SQL against it, and give an engineer clear enough direction that they're not left guessing. You won't be writing production code yourself.
  • Strong written communication. Requirements documents are a core part of this role, so your writing should be clear, specific, and easy for others to build from.

Preferred Experiences:

  • Experience in self-funded employer health: TPA administration, direct contracting, reference-based pricing, or captives.
  • You've run a platform migration or a vendor claims-system implementation and lived through the reporting gap that follows.
  • Founder or early-operator background, or a track record of using automation and AI to replace manual operational work.

Compensation

Additional Information

Nomi Health delivers disruptive healthcare solutions, in partnership with like-minded employers, public sector organizations, advisors (brokers/consultants), and payers/TPAs. We’re a team of 300+ people who show up every day with the same mindset: don’t settle for “that’s just how it is.” Real change happens when you challenge the system, cut through the excuses, and build something better together.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

To scale this impact, we are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager, AI & Automation to be a hands-on developer responsible for designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems to support a digital-first post-sales strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.
  • End-to-End Execution: Write code, execute experimental tests, and continuously maintain production solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner across teams to ensure a cohesive experience for all users.

Success is measured by key customer outcome metrics, including increased adoption, minimized churn risk, and higher NRR tied to the agents you deploy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Analyze: Identify customer painpoints and areas of opportunity with an analytical mindset combined with a customer-centric lens.
  • Build: Build the digital CS playbooks, taking advantage of the programs and resources other teams have built, design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), build guardrails, and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.
  • Test: Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.
  • Deploy: Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs. Ensure anything we deploy makes the experience more simple, not more complex, for our customers.
  • Monitor: Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.
  • Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations, with at least 1 year working directly with LLMs or AI agents in production
  • Ability to code rapidly with Python proficiency or skilled at using AI to code; have a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools
  • Experience using product usage data to spot risk and opportunity (health signals, activation milestones, usage floors) and acting on it before it surfaces in a renewal conversation
  • Comfort running experiments and drawing sound conclusions from the data in order to improve the performance
  • A systems mindset for managing a high-volume book of business: you build repeatable playbooks and motions, not just manage individual relationships
  • 3+ years of experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs
  • Experience building programs to support NRR, retention, or expansion outcomes on a digital or long-tail book of business (100+ accounts)
  • Experience building regression test suites or eval frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Experience in a product-led or high-velocity customer environment

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

  • You’ll be first. This function doesn’t exist yet. You’ll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for digital customer success at Samsara.
  • The problem is real. A CSM managing 350+ accounts can’t do everything manually. Digital and agentic motions are what make this segment sustainable at Samsara’s scale.
  • The timing is right. The models have caught up to the use cases, and Samsara has the customer data, platform context, and Customer Success team to make these systems genuinely powerful.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Scaled Customer Success team ensures customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Scaled Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Finance, Renewals, Sales Engineering, Customer Education and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This position will take on a more technical approach to account management than a typical CSM, a successful candidate will be able to learn, understand, and convey the value of Samsara’s most complex products and features to our largest Mid-Market customers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn, investigate, diagnose and resolve technical issues for customers.
  • Drive business transformation by leading strategic customer engagements to deeply understand current operations and business goals, allowing for proactive workflow transformations and architecting action plans that define the metrics and timelines necessary to remove barriers and deliver business value.
  • Orchestrate product consultation workshops and value check-ins for our most complex partnerships, leading to feature and workflow change recommendations that help customers get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Influence internal roadmaps across Product, Finance, and Support to drive mission-critical customer initiatives.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3 - 5+ years of experience in a technical customer success, account management, sales, sales engineering or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Has strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Has experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with APIs and integrations.
  • Knowledge Sharer: Experience with technical enablement and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Adept in Big Data: Familiarity with tools like Databricks and PowerBI.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with Routing, Navigation, Commercial Trucking Fleets, and Logistics.

$72,887.50—$98,000 USD

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.
  • Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.
  • Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.
  • Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.
  • Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.
  • Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.
  • Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.
  • Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.
  • Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.
  • Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.
  • Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.
  • A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including working to deadlines in an approval process.
  • Familiarity with order forms, amendments, and terms, and how they flow into billing.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent, and rigorous case management so nothing drops across weeks and stakeholders.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience handling escalated or high-dollar billing disputes.
  • Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or an equivalent ERP, and CPQ tools. We also use Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.
  • Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.
  • Experience building or improving billing dispute processes.
  • Exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Strong bias for action and insistence on high standards

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Federal business, and we're looking for the Sales leader who will build out the team and strategy. As the AVP of Federal Sales, you will be the first and most senior specialized Federal hire, accountable for taking the Samsara Connected Operations Cloud into U.S. federal civilian agencies as part of Phase 1 and defense agencies as part of Phase 2 on a dedicated, FedRAMP-authorized government cloud environment.

Federal agencies run some of the largest vehicle and asset fleets in the world, and they are modernizing how they manage safety, maintenance, sustainability, and mission readiness. Samsara already partners with state and local government agencies across the country, including statewide programs. This role turns that foundation into a durable federal practice.

You will operate as the leader of a dedicated federal practice: you'll design the team, hire it, set the go-to-market strategy, shape our partner and contract-vehicle approach, and own federal bookings. You'll work hand in hand with Product, Security and Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to make Samsara easy for federal agencies to buy and trust. This role reports to the Vice President of Public Sector Sales.

This is a remote position open to candidates based on the East Coast (Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Florida), with a preference for candidates based in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. This position requires travel up to 40% of the time.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and own Samsara's federal go-to-market strategy for civilian agencies, including agency prioritization, territory design, and a multi-year plan that sequences investment against certification milestones and the federal budget cycle - with a plan to expand to defense agencies in the future
  • Build Samsara's federal route-to-market with Partnerships: distributors and resellers, contract vehicles such as GSA MAS and GWACs, and co-sell relationships with federal systems integrators
  • Hire, develop, and lead a dedicated federal team of account executives, future business development and capture managers, and solutions engineers, starting with a focused pod and scaling headcount as pipeline and bookings prove out
  • Own federal pipeline and bookings, with clear leading indicators (agency relationships, qualified opportunities, RFI and proposal activity) in the early stage and full bookings accountability once the authorized product is available to transact
  • Develop senior relationships with agency fleet, logistics, operations, and CIO/CISO leaders, and represent Samsara at industry days, federal events, and with government affairs partners
  • Partner with Security and Compliance and Product to translate FedRAMP authorization progress into a clear, accurate customer narrative and to bring agency requirements back into the GovCloud roadmap
  • Work with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to design federal-specific pipeline stages, forecasting, quotas, and compensation plans for long-cycle selling
  • Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts on FAR-compliant terms, teaming agreements, and federal ethics requirements, setting a high bar for compliance across the team
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 12+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with 8+ years selling to U.S. federal government agencies
  • 5+ years leading federal sales teams, including leaders of account executives, as a second-line manager or above
  • Track record of building or scaling a federal sales practice at a commercial-first SaaS, cloud, or IoT company, including selling through and after FedRAMP authorization
  • Consistent over-achievement of federal bookings targets, with closed multi-year, seven-figure agency contracts
  • Hands-on experience with federal acquisition: GSA Schedule and other contract vehicles, distributor and reseller models, and teaming with federal systems integrators
  • Established relationships with federal civilian agency stakeholders, systems integrators, and the federal partner ecosystem
  • Experience leading business development and capture for competitive federal procurements, from pre-RFP shaping through proposal and award
  • Eligibility to obtain a Public Trust position

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A network that includes experienced federal sellers, capture managers, and solutions engineers who would follow them to a new practice
  • Experience co-selling with federal systems integrators inside a direct sales organization, including clear account ownership and compensation rules
  • Familiarity with Shipley or a comparable capture and proposal methodology
  • Experience designing activity-based or MBO compensation for federal teams before authorized product is available
  • Working knowledge of FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS, Section 508 accessibility, and Buy American and Trade Agreements Act requirements, and how they show up in deals
  • Experience with Department of Defense or National Guard fleet programs, as a foundation for future expansion

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
