jobs.jobDescription:
About Wurl, LLC.

At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue.

In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150+ person startup as well as the stability of a high-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

Staff Platform Engineer:

Wurl is seeking a Staff Platform Engineer to build and operate the systems that power our ad-serving and streaming platforms. You’ll be the key technical leader driving the vision and evolution of the infrastructure foundation that enables our teams to deploy, scale, and observe high-throughput, low-latency workloads serving hundreds of thousands of requests per second.

You’ll own the platform layer, ensuring it’s reliable, cost-efficient, and measurable, while enabling multiple engineering teams to deliver world-class video and advertising experiences.

Responsibilities

Platform Infrastructure & Automation

  • Define, architect, and set standards for composable IaC (CDK or Terraform) patterns for Cloud Infrastructure (EKS).
  • Drive the adoption and implement composable, idempotent, multi-environment GitOps workflows.
  • Optimize scalability and cost-per-performance using metrics-driven automation and autoscaling technologies such as Karpenter.

Observability & Reliability

  • Develop and maintain observability across the platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with application teams to define SLOs and capacity models for mission-critical services.
  • Lead major production incident response efforts, drive blameless postmortems, and mentor other engineers on production incident response, postmortems, and reliability reviews.

Delivery & Culture

  • Create and operate resilient CI/CD pipelines for safe, rapid deployments and rollbacks.
  • Champion automation, low-toil operations, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Develop agentic workflows utilizing the team-wide context layer and operational data to accelerate development without compromising reliability.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor to elevate the team, with a strong ability to listen, evaluate, and give constructive feedback on ideas.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in architecting, deploying, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems in cloud production environments, ideally in Platform, SRE, or DevOps roles. Prior ownership of a stateful deployment
  • Deep expertise in systems-level coding skills for automation and systems development (Go, Python, or TypeScript).
  • Proven experience operating Kubernetes at scale (EKS preferred) and applying IaC patterns (CDK, Terraform).
  • Working knowledge of GitOps and reconciliation loops in Kubernetes controllers.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline)

Operational Excellence

  • Expert in defining, designing, and optimizing global monitoring and alerting pipelines (PromQL, metrics correlation, alert noise reduction).
  • Experience with large-scale streaming or ad-serving workloads, including HTTP-based delivery (oRTB, VAST), event streaming (Kafka), and AWS network architecture (VPC, load balancers, peering)
  • Understanding of cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption, network segmentation, zero trust).
  • Proven ability to conduct deep performance analysis, tuning, and optimization across the entire infrastructure stack to achieve optimal cost-per-performance and latency targets.

A Plus if you have:

  • Experience with advanced GitOps patterns using Github Workflows.
  • Exposure to extended observability tools such as Loki or Tempo
  • Experience designing or operating distributed, high-throughput stateful data pipelines to ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient data flow.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Bonus
  • Strong Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits, 100% paid by Wurl
  • Remote first policy
  • Flexible Time Off
  • 10 US Holidays
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Pre-Tax Savings Plans, HSA & FSA
  • Ginger, Aaptiv and Headspace subscriptions for mental and physical wellness
  • OneMedical subscription for 24/7 convenient medical care
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave for all family additions
  • Discounted PetPlan and easy at home access to Covid testing with empowerDX

Few companies allow you to thrive like you will at Wurl. Join us to revolutionize the way the world watches television while enjoying mentorship, collaboration, and innovation.

We encourage all applicants, even those who don’t meet 100% of the requirements, to apply. Passion and potential go a long way here at Wurl.

Depending on the position offered, equity, and other forms of incentive compensation (as applicable) may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to dental, vision, and other benefits.

The Role

Wpromote is seeking an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our accounting team. This hands-on role will oversee key accounts receivable functions, including client billing, account reconciliations, and resolving complex billing discrepancies. The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of accounting, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of transactions while maintaining accurate financial records. This individual will partner cross-functionally to improve processes, strengthen client relationships, and support an efficient month-end close.

You Will Be

  • Managing high-volume client billing, invoice processing, and account maintenance to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

  • Reconciling client accounts, researching discrepancies, and resolving billing issues and short payments.

  • Partnering with Client Services and internal Finance teams to address client inquiries and resolve account discrepancies.

  • Managing client billing setup and updates to ensure accurate invoicing and account records.

  • Supporting month-end close through accurate invoicing, reconciliations and journal entries,

  • Identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, strengthen internal controls, and improve AR processes and reporting.

  • Maintaining thorough documentation and supporting internal and external audits as needed.

You Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or a related accounting role.

  • Strong understanding of AR processes, client billing, account reconciliations, and financial reporting.

  • Experience managing high transaction volumes and independently resolving complex account discrepancies.

  • Proficiency with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system.

  • Solid Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Finance Manager to be the finance partner to the people who run our manufacturing network. You’ll own the financial picture for our manufacturing sites and our third-party lab network, and help operators fully understand their cost structure and identify opportunities.

This is a role for someone who wants to be close to the physical business. You’ll spend real time in the details of overhead absorption, cost per unit, and vendor economics, and you’ll also be in the room when we decide whether to buy a piece of equipment, open or consolidate a site, or bring work in-house. It’s a high-ownership seat with visibility across Operations and Finance leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Manufacturing Site Leads. Own the finance relationship with each site. Make sure every site lead knows their budget cold, understands what’s driving their variances, and has what they need to act on it. Be the person they call before they make a decision, not after.

  • Partner with the 3P Labs team. Bring financial clarity to the routing decisions this team owns. Build the analysis that shows what each routing choice costs us, and make sure the trade-offs are understood in real time — not discovered at close.

  • Run the operations monthly close. Lead pre-close and prelim close meetings with site leads: align with Cost Accounting in advance, set clear expectations with attendees, drive follow-ups to completion, and ensure every variance explanation is properly quantified and owned.

  • Own the accuracy of manufacturing COGS. Perform expense detail review on fixed overhead COGS to confirm costs are booked correctly. Analyze third-party lab costs to validate routing. Run gold and precious metals margin analyses to confirm we’re pricing to our markup targets.

  • Make the process better every month. This close is not in its final form. We want someone who treats each cycle as an opportunity to remove manual work, tighten timelines, and raise the quality of what comes out the other side.

  • Support strategic decisions. Build the analysis behind manufacturing equipment purchases, manufacturing footprint decisions, and insource vs. outsource evaluations — and have a point of view on the answer, not just the model.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of finance experience, including meaningful time in a physical-product business in a high growth environment

  • Demonstrated success partnering with operators. You’ve built strong working relationships with operators and can translate between operational reality and financial impact in both directions.

  • Strong ownership of recurring processes. You’ve run a close, a forecast cycle, or a reporting cadence and left it better than you found it.

  • Excellent modeling skills - proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and also comfort w/ automating spreadsheet work with Claude Co-Work or other AI tools. Comfortable getting into large, messy datasets.

  • Exceptional communication skills — able to distill complex analysis into a clear recommendation for an executive audience.

  • Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. You’re willing to have backbone with senior stakeholders and push for the right answer.

Req ID: J-1224

Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

*****SIGN ON BONUS OF $1000/$1500 DEPENDING ON SPECIALTY*****

We’re looking for experienced and credentialed outpatient coders to become an integral part of our team. The ideal candidate for this role possesses high attention to detail and a depth of knowledge in medical terminology. This role is fully remote with a flexible schedule, allowing you to help shape the future of healthcare from your own workspace!

We are looking for the following experiences/skills:

  1. Outpatient Coder with 2+ years of multispecialty experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility ED, injections/infusions, Ancillary (Radiology, Labs, Clinic). Recurring therapy services for wound care, US, Radiology, Echo, sleep studies, PT/OT, Dialysis. Experience in EPIC and 3M preferred. Also experience with Denials, NCCI edits, medical necessity and claim edits a plus. While experience in all areas is not required, candidates who possess the majority of this expertise would be strongly preferred.
  2. Strong SDS/OBS coder with a minimum of 3 years' experience in an academic medical center, including Level 1 Trauma. Facility has a high volume of Urology, Cardiology, Gynecology, and Vascular procedures. Experience with PowerChart, Dolbey Fusion and Trucode strongly preferred.
  3. FT coder that can code all diagnostic ancillary services to include all Radiology coding including mammos and Maternity diagnosis coding. Coder will need to be able to commit to 40 hours/week, M-F during normal business hours. Cerner/3M360 systems.
  4. ED coder with 5+ years experience. The ideal candidate will have experience in facility E/M leveling, injections/infusions, and bedside procedures. CCS Required and experience in EPIC and 3M/Solventum required as well.
  5. Outpatient Same-Day Surgery/Observation (OP SDS/OBS) with 5+ years of experience. Surgery expertise includes, but not limited to, General Surgery, Ortho, Plastics and Reconstruction, including breast reconstruction, revision, augmentation, mastectomy, Otolaryngology, Spinal fusions and injections, Cardiology including pacemakers, Transesophageal Echocardiogram, Interventional Radiology, OB/Gyne, Nephrology, Endoscopy, US guidance, and Robotic Procedures. Must be able to code both SDS and OBS and be familiar with Rev Code assignment for surgeries. No injections and infusions or OBS time carvouts. CCS required and experience with EPIC/3M required as well.

What You Will Do:

  • Review medical records and assign accurate codes for diagnoses and procedures.
  • Assign and sequence codes accurately based on medical record documentation.
  • Assign the appropriate discharge disposition.
  • Abstract and enter the coded data for hospital statistical and reporting requirements.
  • Communicate documentation improvement opportunities and coding issues to appropriate personnel for follow up and resolution.
  • Maintain a 95% coding accuracy rate and a 95% accuracy rate for APC assignment and meet site-designated productivity standards.
  • Be responsible for tracking continuing education credits to maintain professional credentials.
  • Attend Datavant Health sponsored education meetings/in-services.
  • Demonstrate initiative and judgment in the performance of job responsibilities.
  • Communicate with co-workers, management, and hospital staff regarding clinical and reimbursement issues.
  • Function in a professional, efficient, and positive manner.
  • Adhere to the American Health Information Management Association’s code of ethics.
  • Be customer-service focused and exhibit professionalism, flexibility, dependability, and a desire to learn.
  • Handle a high complexity of work function and decision-making.
  • Possess strong organizational and teamwork skills.
  • Comply with all HIM Division Policies.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • AHIMA certified credentials (RHIA, RHIT, CCS) or AAPC certified credentials (CPC, CPC-H, COC, CIC or CRC).
  • 2+ years of coding experience in a hospital and/or coding consulting role.
  • Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Same Day Surgery, Observation, Injections/Infusions)
  • Proficiency with most or all of these coding specialties (Ancillary, Emergency Department, Injections/Infusions, E/M leveling)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, adeptness in remote work, and exceptional time management skills.
  • Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software.
  • Required to take and pass annual Introductory HIPAA examination and other assigned testing to be given annually
  • Experience in computerized encoding and abstracting software

What We Offer:

  • Benefits for Full-Time employees: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k Savings Plan w/match, 2 weeks of paid time off, and Paid Holidays, Floating Holidays
  • Benefits for PRN employees: 401k savings plan w/match
  • Free CEUs every year
  • Stipend provided to assist with education and professional dues (AHIMA/AAPC)
  • Equipment: monitor, laptop, mouse, headset, and keyboard
  • Comprehensive training led by a credentialed professional coding manager
  • Exceptional service-style management and mentorship (we’re in this together!)

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Kong’s growing Professional Services organization. This is a highly strategic, customer-facing engineering role focused on helping enterprise customers accelerate adoption of Kong’s API and AI Connectivity platform through hands-on implementation, automation, migration tooling, and solution engineering.

As an FDE, you will work directly alongside customer engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, accelerate migrations, build reusable automation, and deliver production-grade solutions in real-world enterprise environments. You will operate at the intersection of software engineering, architecture, platform engineering, and customer delivery.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building, coding, solving ambiguous problems, and working directly with customers on mission-critical initiatives involving APIs, AI gateways, service connectivity, modernization, and cloud-native platforms.

You will collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to ensure successful customer outcomes while also influencing Kong’s product direction based on field experience.

Working at Kong is a unique opportunity to make a massive impact on Fortune 50/500 customers as they modernize mission-critical systems for the AI era.

What’s in it for you?

Impact

Work directly with some of the world’s largest enterprises to modernize API infrastructure and accelerate AI adoption through Kong’s connectivity platform.

Growth

Accelerate your technical and professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, AI connectivity, automation frameworks, and large-scale enterprise architectures.

Opportunity

Be part of a rapidly growing Professional Services organization that is shaping how enterprises adopt APIs, AI gateways, and modern connectivity platforms globally.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement Kong-based solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premise environments.

  • Lead hands-on implementation efforts for API gateways, AI gateways, service mesh, developer portals, and related connectivity technologies.

  • Build automation frameworks, migration tooling, custom integrations, and reusable accelerators to simplify customer adoption and modernization efforts.

  • Drive migration initiatives from legacy API management platforms to Kong.

  • Work closely with customer developers, platform teams, architects, security teams, and executives to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

  • Develop production-grade code, scripts, plugins, CI/CD integrations, Kubernetes automation, and infrastructure tooling as part of customer engagements.

  • Collaborate with Kong Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on real-world customer feedback and implementation learnings.

  • Create reusable best practices, technical assets, reference architectures, documentation, and design patterns to scale delivery excellence across the organization.

  • Support strategic customer initiatives involving AI connectivity, governance, platform modernization, and cloud-native transformation.

What You’ll Bring:

Experience

  • 8+ years in customer-facing engineering, platform engineering, professional services, site reliability engineering, or software engineering roles.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering and implementation experience.

  • Experience with API gateways, API management, integrations, or distributed systems platforms.

  • Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure expertise.

  • Experience building automation frameworks, deployment tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or migration tooling.

  • Strong proficiency in Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, or Lua.

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, or GitOps frameworks.

  • Prior experience working in API Management, Open Source, Middleware, SaaS, or Infrastructure software companies is highly preferred.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Strong builder mindset with the ability to solve complex technical problems with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving enterprise environments.

  • Passion for working directly with customers and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Highly organized with strong prioritization and execution skills.

  • Passion for innovation, modern infrastructure, APIs, AI, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Team-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

#LI-AW1

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is hiring a Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner to be the senior people leader for our global go-to-market organization. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you will sit on the Chief Revenue Officer’s leadership team and partner with the leaders of Direct Sales, Sales Engineering, Sales and Business Development, Channels, Revenue Operations and Enablement across the Americas, EMEA and APJ.

This is a builder’s role at a pivotal moment. Kong’s Series E is funding global go-to-market expansion, our field teams are growing across more than a dozen countries, and our sales motion is moving from API management to AI connectivity. You will shape how the revenue organization is designed, led, paid and grown, and lead the People Business Partners who support it.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with the CRO and GTM leadership. Be the people voice on the CRO’s staff: org, talent, leadership and culture counsel, and the translation of each year’s revenue plan into a people plan.

  • Design the GTM organization for its next stage. Lead coverage-model changes, spans and layers, regional structures, and role architecture and leveling for sales, solutions engineering, SDR/BDR, partner and enablement roles, including new AI-connectivity selling roles.

  • Run headcount and capacity planning. With Finance, Revenue Operations and Talent Acquisition, build the ramp-adjusted capacity model, sequence hiring by territory and start date, and run a monthly GTM hiring review.

  • Govern sales compensation. With Global GTM Compensation and Total Rewards, shape plan philosophy, OTE and pay-mix benchmarks, quota-setting fairness, rollout, exceptions and disputes.

  • Build the GTM performance system. Run quarterly talent and attainment reviews, calibration, promotion criteria and fair, fast performance management across US, EMEA and APJ employment law.

  • Build the sales leadership bench. Assess first- and second-line leaders, own succession plans for the CRO’s leadership team, coach senior leaders, and launch a front-line sales manager program with Sales Enablement.

  • Shorten ramp and keep top performers. Define 30/60/90 plans with Enablement and Talent Acquisition, track time to quota, find the causes of early attrition and run targeted retention plans.

  • Protect culture, inclusion and engagement in the field. Own the GTM engagement read and the actions that follow, manager effectiveness, belonging and the norms of a distributed team.

  • Own employee relations and people risk for GTM. Lead investigations, restructures and international employment compliance across more than a dozen countries, with Legal and regional People leads.

  • Bring the data. Build the GTM people dashboard (attrition, ramp, attainment distribution, span of control, hiring velocity, representation) and present it at every QBR.

  • Lead the people side of change. Territory realignments, comp-plan changes, reorganizations, acquisition integrations and the field’s shift to AI connectivity.

  • Lead the GTM People Business Partner team and help shape Kong’s People operating model, including how AI and automation change HR work.

What You’ll Bring:

• 12+ years in People, including 5+ years as the lead business partner to a CRO, Chief Sales Officer or SVP of Sales at a B2B software company that at least doubled revenue during your

tenure.

• A background in infrastructure, developer-platform, API, cloud or open-source software. You know how technical sellers, solutions engineers and channel teams work, and how an open-source funnel feeds enterprise sales.

• Experience designing sales organizations with Finance and Revenue Operations: coverage models, spans and layers, role architecture, leveling and ramp-adjusted capacity plans.

• Fluency in sales compensation: OTE and pay-mix benchmarking, quota setting, accelerators and SPIFs, plan rollout, exceptions and disputes, and plans for usage-based products.

• A track record running performance management and talent reviews for quota-carrying teams in the US and in EMEA or APJ, including exits and restructures under different employment laws.

• Experience assessing and developing sales leaders, building succession plans for a revenue leadership team and coaching VP-level executives.

• Data fluency: you build and defend a people dashboard and bring analysis, not anecdotes, to a CRO staff meeting.

• Executive presence and judgment that a CRO and a CPO both trust, with speed and discretion on sensitive issues.

• Based in Southern California, or able to spend regular time in person with GTM leadership, with travel to San Francisco and the field.

How You’ll Work:

You are in the room before the decision, not after it. You say what the data says,

including to the CRO, and you leave managers more capable than you found them.

Nice to Have:

• You have been through a platform-to-AI shift in a company’s sales motion.

• You have integrated an acquired team into a sales organization.

• You have worked in a People function that uses AI and automation in recruiting and operations.

• You have partnered Customer Success and Business Development as well as direct sales.

• You have built or led a team of People Business Partners.

For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
ReSpark - Field Implementation Manager

Location: Remote

The opportunity:

ReSpark is a fast-growing start-up pioneering the future of the industrial scrap recycling industry ($120bn and growing!). We serve the world's leading industrial recyclers, helping them transform industrial and consumer scrap into new, usable materials. Our platform modernizes end-to-end workflows within the scrap recycling industry and is the core solution on which their business runs.

We are seeking a proactive Field Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience Team. This role will help drive progress on customer implementations including hardware configuration, end-user training, and workflow recommendations.

There will be travel involved (~30%) to visit customer sites and drive in-person hardware configuration and product training required for going live on the platform. This is a remote position.

About ReSpark

ReSpark is a venture-backed SaaS company formed through the merger of GreenSpark Software and ReMatter — the two leading modern operations platforms for metal recyclers. Together, we serve over 1,200 metal recycling facilities around the world.

Despite being a crucial part of the recycling ecosystem, the $120B+ scrap metal industry has long lacked intuitive, modern software for managing metal transactions, inventory, and yard operations. ReSpark exists to change that. With 12 years of combined production experience, our platform follows the metal all the way through the yard — from point of purchase through ultimate sale — all under one roof.

Today, we're building the AI-first operations layer for the recycling industry: an agentic platform that doesn't just digitize scrap yard workflows, but actively runs them.

We're a mission-driven team of innovators built on principles of competitive greatness, autonomy, and collaboration. Our culture is one of transparency, mutual respect, and constructive feedback — all aimed at collective progress and a brighter, more sustainable future.

As an Implementation Manager, you will:

  • Lead end-to-end software implementations for new ReSpark customers
  • Travel to scrap yards for in-person go-lives and training on a regular basis
  • Become an expert on the ReSpark product, its use cases for recyclers, and how ReSpark helps recyclers operate more efficiently and improve business outcomes
  • Configure customer hardware supporting ReSpark’s software platform such as IP cameras, scales, and printers
  • Lead virtual and live end-user trainings during and after onboarding
  • Hone your customer experience skill-set including clear communication, expectation-setting, problem-solving, and more

We’re looking for someone that has:

  • 4+ years of prior success in a customer-facing role, preferably in training, support, or a related function in a SaaS environment
  • Prior work experience with Windows operating system, remote desktop software, and other software/IT programs
  • Experience installing and setting up hardware (E.g. cameras, scales)
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • A positive attitude and can-do mindset
  • Strong self-motivation, grit, and a competitive spirit
  • A customer-first mindset and bias towards action
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment

Nice to have:

  • Fluent Spanish is a huge plus!

Benefits:

  • Flexible time off policy to balance your work and life
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k)
  • Great start-up culture

ReSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ReSpark’s employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Compensation Range: $85,000-$95,000

The Mission:

We are living through the most significant technological shift since the dawn of the internet. At Kong, we aren't just watching the AI revolution, we are building the infrastructure that makes it possible. We are the intelligent nervous system for modern architecture, seamlessly connecting APIs, microservices, and LLMs for the world’s most ambitious brands.

As enterprises race to integrate AI, they face a wall of complexity. We are the bridge. We help the global 2000 modernize their legacy systems and securely unlock the power of AI across their entire organization. This isn't just sales; it’s architecting the future of global commerce.

The Role: Impact & Ownership:

We are looking for a strategic, high-achieving, and disciplined Enterprise Account Executive to join our world-class team. At Kong, we don't leave success to chance. We are a "master the craft" company. We rely on proven frameworks, deep technical curiosity, and collaborative execution.

If you thrive when navigating complex, high-stakes deals and love the challenge of selling transformational technology to visionary CTOs and Chief Architects, you’ve found your next home.

  • Pioneer New Markets: Lead the full sales cycle to welcome new six- and seven-figure enterprise partners into the Kong ecosystem.

  • Master the Framework: Use the MEDDIC methodology not just as an acronym, but as a strategic tool to uncover value, mitigate risk, and drive predictable success.

  • Technical Curiosity: You have a passion for infrastructure, DevOps, or AI-enabling technologies. You don't just sell the product; you understand the "why" behind it.

  • Strategic Discipline: You value a structured approach. You know that sustainable, scalable success comes from mastering the playbook and executing with precision.

About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. We bring the energy of in-store experiences online, transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships.

At Firework, you’ll be part of a high-growth, team-centric environment where innovation thrives and collaboration fuels success. Having raised over $235m to date led by investors such as the SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and operating at a global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work cross-functionally, solve complex challenges, and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected digital commerce.

If you’re curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas, Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape the next era of online shopping—together.

Summary

We’re looking for a highly-driven Sr. Enterprise Account Executive professional to own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and discovery through close and account expansion. You’ll evangelize Firework’s innovative solutions to large enterprise brands and retailers across a variety of industries in the North America market. You thrive identifying and closing key opportunities with organizations that have complex needs to continuously generate new revenue.

What you'll be doing

  • Work cross-functionally with the team to set priorities and make key strategic decisions for identifying, qualifying, and pursuing new business opportunities with enterprise accounts across multiple industries

  • Own the entire enterprise sales cycle from prospecting, initial outreach, lead qualification, discovery, demo, solution design, negotiation, and close

  • Grow, establish, and nurture long-term relationships with key decision-makers by understanding their business objectives and strategic priorities and delivering value in order to meet assigned revenue goals

  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, product demos, and customized proposals tailored to executive audiences

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and Integration Solutions to align on strategies to ensure successful integration and world-class customer experiences

  • Collaborate with leadership to continuously refine processes, playbooks, and frameworks that help shape and scale go-to-market strategies efficiently

We'll be excited if you have

  • 3+ years experience in a full-cycle enterprise-level sales experience, with a proven track record of success in acquiring new business and exceeding sales targets

  • Extensive experience with outbound prospecting, cultivating a territory, and building and closing a robust pipeline of high-value contracts and complex deals

  • Mastery of solution-based selling, complex sales methodologies, and consultative approaches

  • Ability to create and multiply a sales playbook to influence stakeholders on the value proposition and deliver results through multi-threaded evaluations

  • Skilled in leading and navigating multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles (multiple personas and decision paths)

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to technical and non-technical audiences of all levels including executives

  • Extensive experience with various sales tools and tech stack (i.e. Salesforce, Apollo, LinkedIn, etc)

  • AI fluency and a proactive approach to adopting AI tools to strengthen prospecting, personalize outreach, streamline sales workflows, and improve productivity

  • Comfortable with change in a high-growth organization: ability to demonstrate comfort with ambiguity, adapt quickly and be effective in new situations in a highly dynamic setting

  • Start-up mentality; you are team-oriented, resilient, empathetic, and no ego

Compensation

Locations

The role may be remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in the United States.

Compensation

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated base pay range is approximately $100K-$120K. Other factors that impact compensation include commission and stock options.

Don’t hold back

We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. Maven is looking for a Network Operations Manager who will support Maven’s network contracting function and network operations. This is an individual contributor role responsible for managing the full lifecycle of network partnerships—from identifying and vetting new partners to negotiating agreements and ensuring continued amendment management.

You will be the engine behind how Maven evaluates and contracts with network partners, bringing structure and consistency to a function that is critical to our growth. You are a natural relationship builder who is equally comfortable in a contract redline as you are in a partner call, and you know how to balance speed with rigor when building something new. About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

We compete in one of the most dynamic and consolidating markets in software, and we're looking for a leader to make sure we see it more clearly than anyone else.

As Director, Market & Competitive Intelligence, you'll report directly to the CMO and build a world-class intelligence function serving Product Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership. You'll create a unified understanding of our customers, markets, competitors, buyer behavior, growth opportunities, and turn that understanding into decisions that shape how Kaseya positions, prices, sells, and wins.

This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to the executive team, real influence over strategy, and the opportunity to build a function — and a team — from a strong foundation.

You'll answer questions that matter: Which customer segments create the highest long-term value? Why do customers buy, expand, renew, or churn? Which competitors represent the biggest threat, and how do we beat them? Where should Kaseya invest next?

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own Kaseya's competitive intelligence program; competitor profiles, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and early-warning systems for competitor product launches, pricing moves, and M&A activity
  • Lead market intelligence: TAM analysis, market landscape assessments, industry trend analysis, and emerging category evaluation across the MSP and SMB IT landscape
  • Build the enterprise Voice of Customer capability, including customer research, buyer journey analysis, and a best-in-class win/loss program
  • Design and maintain Kaseya's customer segmentation framework and ensure all go-to-market teams operate against a common methodology
  • Own the measurement framework for marketing effectiveness - pipeline influence, revenue contribution, campaign performance, and funnel conversion, moving marketing from descriptive reporting toward predictive intelligence
  • Partner with Data Science and Revenue Operations on AI-enabled models for churn prediction, expansion propensity, and customer lifetime value
  • Serve as a trusted intelligence advisor to executive leadership, producing regular Executive Intelligence Reviews on market movements, competitive threats, customer sentiment, and growth opportunities
  • Embed competitive and market insight into sales onboarding, training, and live deal support and measure its impact on win rates
  • Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team of analysts and researchers, grounded in curiosity, rigor, and commercial impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in competitive intelligence, market intelligence, insights, analytics, product marketing, or corporate strategy
  • 3+ years leading intelligence, insights, analytics, research, or strategy teams or programs
  • B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred; experience in IT management, cybersecurity, MSP/channel, or infrastructure software is a plus
  • Demonstrated success building or significantly scaling an intelligence, insights, or analytics function
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, Voice of Customer programs, competitive intelligence, and win/loss analysis
  • Exceptional analytical and synthesis skills; you move from fragmented data to a clear, defensible point of view, and translate analytics into executive decisions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to C-level executives and large sales audiences
  • Strong cross-functional leadership; able to influence without authority across product, sales, marketing, and corporate development

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in private equity-backed or high-growth, acquisitive software environments
  • Familiarity with the MSP ecosystem and its competitive landscape
  • Experience with CI platforms (e.g., Klue, Crayon), analyst research (Gartner, Forrester, Canalys), and AI/ML analytics initiatives
  • Experience in subscription and retention-based businesses
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

Summary

We’re expanding our North America Sales team and looking for a highly-driven Director, Enterprise Sales who thrives on the hunt. This role is built for someone who loves opening doors, driving enterprise demand, and owning the full sales cycle from first outbound touch to close. You’ll see a sophisticated, multi-product platform into large enterprises, working directly with senior and C-level stakeholders across marketing, e-commerce, and digital innovation.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and execute enterprise account plans grounded in proactive research, outbound prospecting, and strategic demand generation

  • Own the entire enterprise sales cycle from prospecting, initial outreach, lead qualification, discovery, demo, solution design, proposals, procurement, negotiation, and close

  • Drive multi-threaded enterprise conversations across digital, marketing, commerce, innovation, and IT teams

  • Sell a complex SaaS platform by deeply understanding customer challenges and mapping Firework solutions to their business outcomes

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and Integration Solutions to align on strategies to ensure successful integration, world-class customer experiences, and long-term client impact

  • Provide product and GTM feedback to support ongoing product innovation and roadmap development

  • Track KPIs around revenue, pipeline health, and sales activity; refine strategy and decision-making based on insights

  • Travel to client meetings, workshops, and industry events as needed

We'll be excited if you have

  • 5+ years of full-cycle enterprise-level sales experience with a proven hunter mindset and consistent quota achievement in B2B SaaS or platform sales; e-commerce, martech, or digital customer experience preferred

  • Extensive success with outbound prospecting, generating enterprise demand, and building and closing a robust pipeline of high-value contracts and complex deals

  • Mastery of complex, solution-based selling of multi-stakeholder solutions into large enterprises

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to technical and non-technical audiences of all levels including executives

  • AI fluency and a proactive approach to adopting AI tools to strengthen prospecting, personalize outreach, streamline sales workflows, and improve productivity

  • Comfortable with navigating in a fast-paced, high-growth organization: ability to demonstrate comfort with ambiguity, adapt quickly and be effective in new situations in a highly dynamic setting

  • Start-up mentality; you are team-oriented, resilient, empathetic, and no ego

Compensation

Additional Information

Locations

The role may be remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in the United States.

Compensation

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated base pay range is approximately $120K-$140K. Other factors that impact compensation include commission and stock options.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.

About the Role:

Maven is looking for a Head of Member Growth to own one of the most important numbers in the company: enrollments. This role is directly accountable for driving member enrollment into Maven's programs across our core business — and, by extension, the revenue those enrollments generate. You will own the enrollment engine end to end, from awareness through activation, turning eligible lives into engaged members.

Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You'll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-caliber team while remaining deeply hands-on yourself every day. Although it carries a Senior Director title, it is explicitly NOT a leaned-out management position for someone who wants to direct a team from a distance. This is a hard requirement: the person in this seat reads the data themselves, pressure-tests the funnel, drafts the plan, and does the work alongside the team. We are looking for a builder and operator who also develops people — not a manager who has stepped away from the work.

We're also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don't simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client's employees. This role is expected to find and open those new avenues, not just optimize the existing ones.

What You'll Do:

  • Own member growth for the Core Business: Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven's core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.
  • Build and run a scalable enrollment engine: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.
  • Expand the playbook and deliver new strategies to drive sustainable member growth: Think strategically and from first principles about new ways to grow enrollments beyond today's optimization work — including partnerships and approaches that don't rely solely on permission to communicate with a client's employees. Identify, size, and open avenues that expand the team's purview and unlock new growth.
  • Optimize relentlessly around data: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.
  • Hold the cross-functional machine accountable: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.
  • Operate as a player-coach: Lead and develop a small, high-performing team while staying in the execution and details. Set the bar for rigor and hands-on execution by doing the work, coaching through it, and multiplying the team's impact rather than stepping back from it. This is a role that comes with an expectation that you directly execute on the work.
  • Instrument and forecast: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn't working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, or revenue outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.
  • A hands-on player-coach. You are energized by being in the details daily — the data, the funnel, the plan, the execution — and you lead a small team as a way to multiply your own hands-on impact, not to step back from the work. This is a hard requirement for the role.
  • Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.
  • Strategic range. Beyond optimizing what exists, you can spot and pursue fundamentally new approaches to enrollment that expand the team's purview — not just incremental improvements to current channels.
  • Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.
  • Commercial instincts. You understand how enrollment translates into revenue and unit economics, and you can partner with Finance on targets and forecasting.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment with high visibility and direct accountability for a top-line company metric.

GREAT opportunity to grow with rapidly growing company, Kaseya. We are seeking a highly motivated, analytical, and results-driven Senior Accountant – Revenue Accounting to join our Finance organization. This role will be responsible for managing key revenue accounting activities, reviewing customer contracts, ensuring accurate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, and supporting compliance with internal controls and financial reporting requirements. The ideal candidate will bring strong accounting expertise, advanced analytical capabilities, and a demonstrated ability to independently manage monthly close deliverables while maintaining accuracy and meeting critical deadlines. This position offers an exciting opportunity to leverage advanced Excel capabilities, artificial intelligence (AI), and automation to enhance accounting processes, strengthen financial reporting, and drive operational efficiencies within Kaseya's growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze customer contracts to ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606, including the evaluation of non-standard contractual terms and conditions.
  • Manage key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring timely and accurate completion of revenue-related accounting activities.
  • Prepare, review, and post manual journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting financial documentation in accordance with established accounting policies.
  • Perform comprehensive balance sheet reconciliations and completeness analyses for revenue-related accounts, including contract liabilities (deferred revenue), contract assets (unbilled receivables), and accounts receivable.
  • Conduct detailed revenue analytics and flux analyses to identify trends, investigate material variances, and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial reporting.
  • Evaluate complex customer contracts and accounting transactions to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment and assess the financial impact of contractual terms.
  • Support compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements by executing internal controls, maintaining supporting documentation, and ensuring audit readiness.
  • Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities and financial analysis tools to streamline reconciliations, enhance reporting accuracy, and improve accounting efficiency.
  • Identify, develop, and implement opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to optimize revenue accounting workflows and reduce manual processes.
  • Take ownership of assigned monthly close deliverables, including journal entries, contract scoping analyses, account reconciliations, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Finance, Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations, to resolve contract-related accounting matters and ensure alignment with revenue recognition policies.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing detailed schedules, reconciliations, technical accounting documentation, and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Proactively identify accounting risks, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to strengthen financial controls and reporting procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of revenue accounting operations.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • Advanced coursework or professional development in financial accounting, revenue recognition, or financial reporting is preferred.
  • CPA certification or progress toward obtaining CPA licensure is a plus.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of progressive professional experience in accounting, finance, revenue accounting, or a related financial reporting function.
  • Strong understanding of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), financial reporting requirements, and fundamental revenue accounting concepts.
  • Proficient/Foundational experience is preferred in applying ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance, including accounting for customer contracts with non-standard terms and conditions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing accounting deliverables within monthly or quarterly financial close cycles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, lookups, financial reconciliations, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Proven ability to prepare accurate journal entries, perform account reconciliations, investigate variances, and maintain complete financial documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and identify accounting discrepancies.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities, take ownership of deliverables, and consistently meet critical financial close deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a commitment to accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established accounting standards.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial findings and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth business environment.
  • Interest in leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve accounting processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend practical solutions, and contribute to scalable accounting operations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SOX compliance, internal controls, audit documentation, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience performing balance sheet completeness analyses, reconciliations, and flux analyses involving deferred revenue, contract assets, unbilled receivables, and accounts receivable.
  • Prior experience managing revenue-related monthly close activities, including contract scoping analyses, journal entries, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology, or subscription-based business environment, including familiarity with recurring revenue models and complex customer contracts.
  • Advanced Excel capabilities, including Power Query, XLOOKUP, complex financial models, and data transformation techniques.
  • Experience implementing or utilizing AI-powered tools, robotic process automation (RPA), or other technologies to streamline accounting processes.
  • Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and revenue management or financial reporting platforms.
  • Experience collaborating with Legal, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations teams to evaluate contractual terms and resolve revenue accounting matters.
  • Demonstrated success identifying accounting process inefficiencies, implementing improvements, and enhancing financial reporting accuracy.

jobs.jobDescription:
About RFA and Titan

RFA is a leading IT and cybersecurity partner to financial services firms: hedge funds, private equity, asset managers, and the firms that serve them. RFA is part of Titan, which is building the AI workforce for IT.

Titan has raised over $100M from General Catalyst, 8VC, and CalPERS, acquired market-leading IT firms like RFA, and put AI agents into production in large enterprises. We've automated 100K+ tickets across 800+ customers and are leading the industry in service quality. Our tech team has talent from Scale AI, CoreWeave, Vanta, Dropbox, Meta, FiveRings, TwoSigma, Amazon, Harvard, Stanford, and MIT.

Why this role, why now

AI is changing security faster than anything we've seen, and we want RFA to be the one leading it for its clients. RFA's clients answer to regulators, investors, and DDQs, and they expect their IT partner to be the most security-minded team in the room. With Titan's AI agents now working alongside RFA's engineers, we can deliver security that is faster, more thorough, and more proactive than a traditional MSP or MSSP.

We're looking for a CISO for RFA: a security leader who wants to build security for financial firms from the ground up, with AI at the center of how it's delivered.

About the role

As RFA's CISO, you own security for RFA and its clients. You lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, act as the senior security advisor to client leadership, and make sure RFA itself holds up to the scrutiny of the most demanding funds. You'll report to RFA's COO and work closely with RFA's service delivery and engineering teams, and with Titan's product and engineering teams.

You own and measure success by client outcomes (incidents prevented and contained, audits and DDQs passed), growth and retention of RFA's security revenue, and an RFA that passes every client security review.

This role is remote (US).

In this role you will

  • Set RFA's security strategy and lead RFA's GRC, SOC, and vCISO teams, who report to you

  • Build and run RFA's client security offering: vCISO, managed detection and response, SOC, vulnerability management, email security, and incident response, with AI agents doing the volume and people doing the judgment

  • Be the trusted security advisor to client CFOs, COOs, and CCOs: board and investment committee updates, regulatory readiness (SEC, FINRA, Reg S-P, state privacy rules), and investor DDQs

  • Lead incident response for RFA clients, from first alert to client communication and lessons learned

  • Own RFA's own security and compliance program, including SOC 2 and the security questionnaires clients send us

  • Work with Titan's engineers to make sure the AI agents working in client environments are safe: least-privilege access, guardrails, logging, and audit trails

  • Guide RFA clients adopting Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot on AI governance: data boundaries, connector and permission review, shadow AI discovery

  • Join sales cycles as RFA's security voice: win the client's CISO or CCO, and turn what we learn into packaged services and pricing

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 10+ years in security, including leading a security function or practice as CISO, VP, or Head of Security

  • Have built or run security services at an MSP, MSSP, or security consultancy, ideally serving financial services firms

  • Know what hedge funds, PE firms, and asset managers need from security: SEC cybersecurity rules, Reg S-P, investor DDQs, and frameworks like NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

  • Are hands-on with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and modern EDR, SIEM, and email security stacks

  • Are excited, not threatened, by AI agents doing security work, and have opinions on how to make them safe

  • Can explain risk to a fund COO in plain language and to an engineer in technical detail

  • Take extreme ownership and would rather build the program than inherit one

Bonus

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC

  • vCISO experience across multiple financial services clients

  • Experience securing LLM applications or AI governance work (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF)

Logistics

Location: Remote (US)

Travel: Under 5%, for occasional client meetings and time with the team in NYC

jobs.jobDescription:
About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

Summary

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Business Development & Partnerships Manager to own visible, impactful non-linear growth initiatives by identifying, developing, and managing strategic partnership opportunities for Firework. This role will work across external partners and internal teams to support new partnerships, product integrations, and broader strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is someone ready to take the next step up in their career, comfortable working in a fast-moving environment, can operate with ambiguity, and is able to take ownership of projects from early-stage discussions through execution. You will work closely with senior members of the team while also independently managing partner communications, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, and helping move opportunities forward.

What you'll be doing

  • Support the development and execution of strategic partnerships across technology platforms, retailers, brands, agencies, and other ecosystem partners

  • Manage day-to-day partner relationships and communications, including with senior external stakeholders

  • Identify new partnership and business development opportunities and support outreach, evaluation, and follow-up

  • Help structure partnership proposals, commercial models, business cases, and internal recommendations

  • Coordinate partnership discussions across internal teams including Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal

  • Support API-led and product integration partnerships, working with Product and Engineering teams to understand partner requirements, timelines, and implementation needs

  • Track partnership progress, dependencies, deliverables, and next steps to ensure initiatives continue moving forward

  • Prepare presentations, proposals, meeting materials, and executive-level communications for internal and external audiences

  • Conduct research and analysis on potential partners, market opportunities, competitors, and broader industry trends

  • Support broader strategic initiatives, including selected corporate development or strategic evaluation projects where relevant

We’ll be excited if you have

  • 3+ years of professional experience, ideally in partnerships, business development, strategy, consulting, corporate development, or a related role

  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to interact confidently and professionally with senior external stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership, work independently, and proactively move projects forward

  • Comfortable operating in an environment where priorities and opportunities may not always be clearly defined

  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and workstreams

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort developing business cases, presentations, and recommendations

  • Ability to understand commercial and product considerations and translate between different internal teams

  • Experience working on API integrations, technology partnerships, platform integrations, or other product-led partnerships is highly valued

  • Experience in Ad Tech, Retail Media Networks, commerce technology, SaaS, or related industries is a plus, but not required

  • Exposure to corporate development, M&A, strategic investments, or transaction-related work is a plus

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Compensation

Additional Information

Locations

The role may be remote and we are looking for candidates based in the Eastern timezone (EST).

Compensation

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated base pay range for this role is $100,000-$120,000. Other factors that impact compensation include variable compensation and stock options.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.

Don’t hold back

We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.jobDescription:
Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.

We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our VA team, building and maintaining the shared components and forms that help VA.gov teams ship consistent, accessible experiences for Veterans.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build and maintain reusable front-end components using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and web components
  • Extend and improve the VA Design System component library and Forms Library
  • Fix bugs and handle component requests from product teams across VA.gov
  • Write automated tests and Storybook documentation for the components you ship
  • Meet Section 508 and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards in everything you build
  • Work with designers and engineers to turn Figma designs into working, accessible code
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code to speed up delivery while keeping quality high
  • Take part in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience with React and JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Solid HTML and CSS skills, including accessible, semantic markup
  • Understanding of accessibility standards such as WCAG and ARIA
  • Experience with design systems, component libraries, or form-heavy applications is a plus
  • Familiarity with Stencil, web components, USWDS, or SCSS is a plus
  • Familiarity with Storybook and component testing is a plus
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is a plus
  • Thrives in a remote, collaborative Agile environment and genuinely enjoys working with designers and engineers
  • Communicates clearly and openly, whether in a code review or a conversation with a non-technical teammate
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Fully remote
  • Annual Stipend
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Company Match 401(k) plan
