jobs.jobDescription:
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the role

This role is responsible for Maven’s end-to-end benefits and payments platform, including eligibility and enrollments. Maven’s benefits products should be easy to use for members, providers and employers. You will work closely with Engineering and Design teams, as well as with Maven’s Growth and Client Success teams, and with clients.

This is a role for someone who has scaled a benefits or complex B2B2C operational product to the point where it runs quietly, and who has the client-facing judgment to decide what gets built, when, and for whom.

What you'll do

  • Own the benefits product end to end: eligibility, enrollment, claims adjudication, payer and employer reconciliation, and provider payments
  • Make it scale and just work: drive the shift from manual to programmatic reconciliation, self-serve eligibility, and automated claims so member and provider volume grows without operational headcount growing with it
  • Build and enforce a triage framework for custom client requests: evaluate against platform leverage, sequence against the core roadmap, route to the right owner, and communicate decisions with clarity
  • Manage and develop a team of PMs spanning benefits, payments, and eligibility/enrollments

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years in product with meaningful time on benefits, eligibility, claims, or payer systems in a complex B2B2C or healthcare environment.
  • 3+ years experience managing and mentoring PMs
  • A track record of scaling an operational product to reliability: you have taken something manual and error-prone and made it run quietly at volume
  • Deep fluency in how benefits data flows from employer configuration through eligibility verification through member activation, and where it breaks
  • Direct experience with claims infrastructure: submission, adjudication, remittance, reconciliation, and provider payments, and a clear view of the highest-risk points in that pipeline
  • Strong data and instrumentation skills: funnel and reconciliation monitoring, activation analysis, and communicating outcomes to client success, growth, finance, and executive stakeholders
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools as part of how you work today, and a point of view on where AI makes the benefit more reliable at scale
  • High ownership: you operate like a founder and do not wait for direction

The base salary range for this role is 260,000-285,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. This role is open to candidates in remote locations with a strong preference for San Francisco, CA; secondary locations include Seattle, WA and New York, NY.

Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

About the Role

As an Onboarding Manager, you will play a pivotal role in encouraging partners to engage with and participate in MSP Enablement programs as soon as possible after the point of sale. You will set milestones for new program participants, encourage users to move through the process in a quick and efficient manner, and run meetings to integrate members into their assigned groups. Additionally, you will update systems, train partners on using our platforms, track members post-onboarding, provide feedback for process improvements, and assist with event production as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Encourage partners to engage with and participate in MSP Enablement programs as soon as possible after the point of sale.
  • Set milestones for new program participants as they navigate the onboarding process and begin interacting with the MSP enablement community and TruMethods Peer groups. Influence Peer group placement by communicating known information to program management and operations functions.
  • Run one-to-one and one-to-many meetings, following a process to integrate peer members into their assigned groups.
  • Update systems as designed and documented, appropriately leveraging systems for communication and relationship management.
  • Train partners on how to use the MSP Enablement platforms to access the software and content needed to successfully participate in MSP Enablement programs.
  • Track members post-onboarding to ensure that the onboarding program equips members to be successful.
  • Provide feedback on how to improve processes, assisting with implementation and improvements that promote a positive program experience for partners.
  • Assist with event production by attending in-person and virtual peer quarterly events as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven experience in onboarding, customer service, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Proficiency in using CRM systems and other relevant software.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to attend in-person and virtual events as required.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Allen Integrated Solutions is seeking a highly skilled Subject Matter Expert in Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) research engineering to support the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in infrared sensing, space-based missile warning systems, data exploitation, and algorithm development. The ideal candidate will possess an extensive technical background in electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) systems, infrared phenomenology, OPIR data analysis, and remote-sensing software development. This role requires demonstrated experience working with complex sensor systems, leading the development and testing of advanced analytical capabilities, and collaborating with government, industry, and research partners on next-generation sensing technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the prototyping and development of advanced OPIR data-processing algorithms and support their transition into operational environments.
  • Evaluate and troubleshoot data-processing pipelines, identify anomalies, and coordinate remediation strategies.
  • Support the development of white papers, technical documentation, and technology-transition plans.
  • Collaborate with research organizations, Department of Defense stakeholders, Intelligence Community organizations, and external agencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • At least 15 years of experience in EO/IR algorithm development.
  • Advanced understanding of EO/IR signal processing, artificial intelligence and machine learning applications, and target-system phenomenology.
  • Detailed experience with OPIR data formats and processing pipelines.
  • Advanced Python development skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose sensor-performance issues, data anomalies, and software problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience performing OPIR analysis.
  • Master’s degree in computer engineering, physics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience collaborating with NGA, NASIC, or other Intelligence Community organizations.

  • Conduct analysis, exploitation, and modeling of infrared and OPIR sensor data, including Space-Based Infrared System (SBIRS) data.
  • Develop, prototype, and implement advanced data-processing algorithms using Python, MATLAB, and other analytical environments.
  • Investigate sensor and target phenomenology and develop test plans, sensor-collection scenarios, and experiments to address complex detection and tracking challenges.
  • Evaluate and troubleshoot data-processing workflows, identify anomalies or software-logic issues, and coordinate remediation strategies.
  • Support the development of concepts of operations (CONOPS), white papers, technical documentation, and transition plans for emerging sensor capabilities and processing architectures.
  • Collaborate with research organizations, Department of Defense stakeholders, Intelligence Community organizations, and external agencies to evaluate and integrate emerging sensing and exploitation technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, computer engineering, space systems, or a related technical field.
  • At least six years of experience in EO/IR systems engineering, OPIR analysis, remote sensing, or a related mission area.
  • Demonstrated experience with OPIR data formats, processing workflows, or SBIRS exploitation tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose sensor-performance issues, data anomalies, and software-logic problems.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience collaborating with NASIC or other Intelligence Community organizations.
  • Experience developing CONOPS, technical documentation, or training materials.

jobs.jobDescription:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

About the Retail team

  • Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

  • Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

  • Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

  • Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

  • Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

  • Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

What you'll bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

  • Own partner metrics and reporting: build systematic tracking of AWS Partner KPIs (including AO/PO) and internal metrics across segments, and turn them into forecasts and insights for sales leadership
  • Run regular cadences with the AWS partner team and internal stakeholders to track progress and deliver business reviews

  • Represent Loka at AWS partner events, District offsites and industry conferences

  • Track AWS ecosystem developments and market trends, and proactively identify and act on growth opportunities without waiting for direction

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years in alliances, partner or channel roles within the AWS ecosystem
  • Hands-on knowledge of how AWS partner teams work: partnering with PDMs, running reports out of ACE, and co-sell and AO/PO motions
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience building metrics, reporting and forecasts that leadership relies on
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Comfort with ambiguity and high autonomy
  • Ability to travel for District offsites and AWS events up to 50% of the month
  • Eligible to work in the US without sponsorship

STRONGLY PREFERRED

  • Experience at a professional services or cloud consulting company
  • Existing relationships with AWS PDMs or District Managers
  • Working knowledge of AWS partner programs and funding
  • Exposure to Anthropic (Claude) or OpenAI partner programs
  • AWS certifications

  • Salary range $160,000–$190,000

  • 401k with up to 4% employer matching
  • LokaLabs™: Apply moonshot technologies to overlooked societal challenges in our internal incubator.
  • Continuous Learning Support

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at accommodations@sierra.ai. Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

jobs.jobDescription:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of Speed with Integrity, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:

  • Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
  • Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
  • One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

At Yubico, we offer:

Yubico Values: We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work here).

Social Connection: Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our Life at Yubico Page on LinkedIn and our awards here.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.

Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.

This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership: Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.
  • Customer focus: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products
  • Requirements Definition: Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.
  • Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution: Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.
  • Data-driven Insights: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.
  • Full life cycle management: Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes
  • Security & Compliance Management: Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.
  • Leadership & Acumen: Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cryptographic Systems: Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.

U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:

Health coverage. We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.

Retirement plan. Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.

Wellness reimbursement. We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.

Learning and development. We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program.

Time off. We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.

Paid parental leave. We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total).

Commuter Benefits. If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits.

Strong mission & company values. We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.

#LI-BR1
#LI-Remote

Yubico offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work. This role has the annual salary range as defined below for a salary pay range for a candidate located in the San Francisco Bay Area. For roles that are filled in other locations, the compensation range will be based on data provided by the Radford McLagan Compensation Database from Aon. Final compensation is also based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Salary Pay Range

$175,000—$210,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.

Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.

Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). Your personal data will only be used for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with the Yubico Privacy Notice. We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. If you have asked us to, we will keep you informed of other opportunities at Yubico. We do this in various ways, including email and by phone. If at any time you do not want us to contact you or use your information as described herein please contact us at jobs@yubico.com to let us know and we will delete all such information. Providing your personal data is voluntary, but necessary to join our talent community, and if you do not agree to provide your data, we will not be able to consider you as part of our talent community.

As part of providing the requested service, we will transfer your data to be processed by Greenhouse Software Inc., a service provider contracted by Yubico AB and/or its subsidiaries that meets legally mandated privacy requirements. The Yubico Privacy Notice offers more information about Yubico privacy practices, including the lawful basis for processing of personal data, how to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, and how to contact Yubico to exercise your data subject rights. In this notice, when we refer to "Yubico", "us", "we" or "our", we mean the Yubico group company or companies that you apply to, or correspond with, and which are responsible for any personal data collected about you.

jobs.jobDescription:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About the Role

Later is seeking an Account Supervisor to drive strategic client partnerships and deliver best-in-class influencer marketing programs. In this role, you’ll own the success of key accounts, shaping integrated strategies, leading cross-functional execution, and ensuring every campaign delivers measurable business impact.

You will serve as a senior client partner and internal leader — overseeing Account Managers and Coordinators, guiding strategic direction, and acting as a trusted advisor to brands. This is a high-impact role that combines client strategy, operational excellence, and team leadership to strengthen Later’s position as a top partner in the creator economy.

What You’ll Do

Strategy

  • Lead the development of influencer marketing strategies that align with client objectives and deliver measurable ROI.

  • Build and nurture senior client relationships, positioning Later as a trusted strategic advisor.

  • Facilitate strategic business reviews and campaign reporting that translate performance into actionable next steps.

  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities within accounts, partnering with Sales and Strategy to grow revenue.

  • Contribute to RFPs and new business pitches by bringing client insights and proven campaign expertise.

Technical / Execution

  • Oversee execution of multiple influencer campaigns from kickoff to wrap, ensuring quality, compliance, and measurable impact.

  • Guide Account Managers in managing day-to-day client communications and executional tasks.

  • Own campaign budgets, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are on track and aligned with client commitments.

  • Ensure campaigns meet FTC guidelines and platform standards while maintaining creative excellence.

  • Monitor campaign KPIs, surface insights, and recommend optimizations to improve performance.

Team / Collaboration

  • Partner with Social, Strategy, Creator Success, Paid Media, Product, and Sales to deliver seamless integrated campaigns.

  • Act as the voice of the client and influencer, ensuring feedback informs platform improvements and future strategies.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to embed innovation and elevate Later’s reputation with clients and across the industry.

Leadership

  • Manage and mentor direct reports, building a high-performing, client-focused team.

  • Provide coaching, performance feedback, and growth opportunities to Account Managers and Coordinators.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Anticipate risks early and implement proactive solutions that remove blockers for the team.

Research / Best Practices

  • Stay ahead of industry trends, platforms, and cultural shifts — embedding innovation into client strategies.

  • Contribute thought leadership to position Later as a market leader in influencer and creator marketing.

  • Build and maintain internal processes that guarantee compliance and operational excellence across accounts.

What Success Looks Like

  • Key client accounts achieve renewal and expansion targets, with measurable ROI from campaigns.

  • Later is seen as a trusted strategic partner, not just an executional vendor.

  • Campaigns are consistently delivered on time, on budget, and above quality standards.

  • Account Managers and Coordinators under your leadership grow in performance and confidence.

  • Later’s Services team is recognized for innovation, compliance rigor, and best-in-class execution.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, or digital campaign management, with direct client-facing experience.

  • Proven ability to lead client strategy and deliver results against brand objectives.

  • 2+ years of strong management experience, including coaching, performance reviews, and day-to-day team leadership.

  • Deep knowledge of social platforms, influencer best practices, and compliance requirements.

  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate performance into actionable insights.

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Track record of driving account growth and strengthening client partnerships.

How You Work

  • Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter—prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
  • Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast—challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.
  • Collaborative & Resilient: You thrive in change by staying resourceful, solution-focused, and positive—removing roadblocks, sharing insights, and keeping morale high.
  • Accountable & Honest: You own your work, hold yourself and others to a high bar, and use transparent feedback to drive growth.
  • Emotionally Intelligent: You build trust through empathy and collaboration, foster inclusion, and inspire others with grit, optimism, and integrity.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Total Compensation Range: $115,000 - $140,000 OTE

#LI-Hybrid

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

jobs.jobDescription:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

As an Enterprise Account Director at Later, you will own a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise client relationships, typically representing $5M-$15M in annual business depending on account size and complexity.

You will operate as the CEO of the account, with significant autonomy and accountability for setting the account strategy, building executive relationships, driving expansion, and determining how Later should invest to deepen and grow each partnership.

This is a senior commercial and strategic leadership role within the evolving creator and influencer marketing ecosystem. You will advise some of the world’s leading brands on how influencer and creator marketing can support broader brand, commerce, customer acquisition, and growth objectives, while helping them navigate a rapidly changing social landscape.

You will bring a strong point of view on creator strategy, social trends, measurement, and the influencer ecosystem, while translating client business priorities into meaningful opportunities for Later. Success in this role requires strong commercial instincts, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise organizations with a high degree of independence.

What you'll be doing:

Enterprise Account Strategy & Growth

  • Own the long-term strategy and growth plan for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients representing approximately $5M-$15M in annual business.
  • Develop a clear growth thesis for each account, including expansion opportunities, stakeholder strategy, competitive dynamics, risks, and areas where Later can create additional value.
  • Drive expansion by identifying whitespace, developing opportunities, and building the executive alignment required to increase Later’s strategic and commercial footprint.
  • Connect client business priorities to opportunities across influencer marketing, creator strategy, social, commerce, and Later’s broader capabilities.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of each partnership, anticipating changes in client priorities, organizational structure, competitive dynamics, and the broader creator and social landscape.
  • Partner with Sales on commercial strategy, renewals, and expansion while maintaining overall ownership of the client relationship and account direction.

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with VP, C-suite, and senior decision-makers across complex enterprise organizations.
  • Develop multi-threaded relationships that extend beyond individual champions and create durable executive sponsorship for Later.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, bringing proactive recommendations and a clear point of view on creator strategy, influencer marketing, social trends, measurement, and emerging opportunities.
  • Help senior marketers understand how creator and influencer programs can support broader brand, performance, commerce, and customer growth objectives.
  • Lead strategic business reviews, executive strategy sessions, workshops, and other high-value client engagements.
  • Navigate complex or sensitive client conversations with confidence, judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach.

CEO of the Account

  • Operate with significant autonomy in determining how Later approaches, supports, and grows each assigned account.
  • Set the strategic direction for the partnership and mobilize the right internal teams and executive stakeholders to deliver against that vision.
  • Maintain a holistic understanding of account performance, client sentiment, commercial opportunity, stakeholder dynamics, competitive risk, and delivery health.
  • Identify risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional action before they become material client or commercial issues.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about where Later should invest time, expertise, and resources to maximize the long-term value of the partnership.

Creator & Influencer Strategic Leadership

  • Bring a strong understanding of the creator and influencer ecosystem and how it is evolving across social, media, commerce, and culture.
  • Translate market trends, platform shifts, creator behavior, and performance insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Challenge client thinking when appropriate and help them identify new ways to use creator and influencer marketing to solve business problems.
  • Partner with Strategy, Services, Data, and Product teams to develop differentiated solutions that reflect client objectives and emerging market opportunities.
  • Use client feedback and market insight to help shape Later’s services, products, and strategic priorities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

$175,000- $225,000 OTE

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position

We’re looking for a Director of Creator Operations to own the systems and processes that connect how Later finds, engages, and supports creators. Creators are on one side of every campaign we run, and as we bring the creator experience together across our programs, we need one leader to design how outreach, success, and support work as a single system. Mavely is the core of this role, and the scope extends to how we support affiliate creators across Later Influence.

You’ll own both ways we bring creators in: the sales-led motion, where our team reaches creators person to person, and the product-led motion, where outreach runs at scale through the product. Reporting to the VP of Revenue and Business Operations as part of Later’s Operations team, you’ll partner closely with the General Manager of Creator, Creator Growth, Creator Success, Creator Support, Product, and Engineering. You’ll manage one direct report, who owns HubSpot design and administration, and direct engineering and product resources on the integrations between our systems. This is a high-visibility role with regular exposure to senior leadership.

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and targets

  • Own the infrastructure behind creator acquisition and engagement across the sales-led and product-led motions, from first touch through activation and campaign participation.
  • Build the creator acquisition targets, and the forecast behind them, with the General Manager of Creator, so Creator Growth leadership has a number they can execute against and see coming.
  • Shape funnel strategy jointly with Creator Growth: they own the number and its execution, and you own the structure, the forecast, and the target model it runs on.
  • Own the roadmap for a consolidated creator engagement and tracking system, and decide what gets built and in what order.
  • Turn creator funnel data into decisions on where to put outreach effort, headcount, and automation.

Systems and integration design

  • Act as the primary integration designer between the creator product experience and the Success and Support teams that engage creators.
  • Partner with Product the way a product manager would: write the requirements for engagement flows, routing, and handoffs, and work with Engineering to ship them.
  • Own HubSpot as the system of record for creator marketing, engagement tracking, and the person-to-person outreach our Creator Success team runs.
  • Consolidate the creator outreach tech stack: assess each tool, retire the overlap, and make the remaining systems work from one shared record of each creator.
  • Own the budget for HubSpot and the other creator engagement tools, and decide where that spend goes as the stack consolidates.
  • Use AI and automation to take manual work out of outreach, routing, and follow-up, and measure what it saves.

Outreach and engagement operations

  • Own the systems behind product-led outreach to creators at scale, including segmentation, triggers, sequencing, and measurement.
  • Design the routing and handoff rules that move a creator between automated outreach and a person on our team at the right moment.
  • Build the engagement flows that bring affiliate and awareness creators into campaigns and keep them participating.
  • Define the standards (data definitions, field governance, and service levels) that keep outreach, success, and support data accurate and trusted.

Leadership and team

  • Lead and develop your HubSpot design and administration direct report with clear goals, regular coaching, and a growth plan.
  • Set the talent bar for Creator Operations and raise it with each hire and each process you ship.
  • Address performance gaps quickly and directly, in partnership with People.
  • Direct engineering and product work on integrations through clear requirements, priorities, and follow-through.
  • Clear blockers for the Creator Success and outreach teams before they escalate.

What success looks like

  • Within your first 60 days, you have mapped how creators are acquired, engaged, and supported today across every tool and team, set a baseline for the creator funnel, and shipped at least one change that removes manual work for Creator Success.
  • By 90 days, the plan to consolidate the creator outreach tech stack is agreed with Product and Engineering, and you have built the creator acquisition, activation, and campaign participation targets, with a forecast that the General Manager of Creator and Creator Growth leadership have signed off on.
  • By 6 months, the consolidated engagement and tracking system is live for Mavely: every creator touch, automated or personal, is tracked on one record, and routing between product-led and person-to-person outreach runs on documented rules.
  • By 12 months, the creator engagement stack is consolidated onto one system that supports all of Later’s affiliate creators, and affiliate creator acquisition is growing faster than the baseline you set in your first 60 days, without added headcount. In addition, your direct report owns the HubSpot platform day to day, and Creator Operations is the team the General Manager of Creator relies on to set creator targets and forecast them accurately.

What you bring

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • 6-8 years in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Growth Operations, with a track record of building the systems behind a high-volume acquisition funnel.
  • Experience running B2C or creator-facing outreach at scale across both product-led and person-to-person motions, including designing how the two hand off.
  • Deep HubSpot experience, including designing lifecycle stages, workflows, routing, and engagement tracking for a team that works directly with customers or creators.
  • A track record of designing integrations between a product and the go-to-market systems around it, working with Product and Engineering on requirements, prioritization, and release.
  • Experience building targets and forecasts for a sales or outreach team that another leader executes against: you can build the model, set the number, and explain the gap.
  • A record of using AI and automation to remove manual work from operations, with results you can measure.
  • Experience leading through others, including managing a direct report, owning a tooling budget, and directing technical work across teams without formal authority.
  • You get up to speed quickly in a new domain, break complex multi-system problems into concrete plans with owners and milestones, and own the result end to end.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (for example, Klaviyo, Braze, or Iterable) is a plus.
  • An understanding of social platforms and how creators build audiences and earn on them is a plus.
  • Experience in the creator economy, affiliate marketing, or a two-sided marketplace is a plus.

jobs.jobDescription:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

About The Role

We're looking for a software engineer to own the architecture, data handling, and product layer of the software stack at one of Valinor’s product companies, currently in stealth. The system turns raw sensor data into a usable, trusted picture for the end user. You'll work directly with the General Manager and alongside a small team of engineers to rapidly develop a new product. You’ll also partner with product enablement at the Valinor Hub to stand up infrastructure and management.

We see this as a step-up role: someone who has already been part of building a system like this, whether embedded/edge software, sensor or data pipelines, or detection and classification work, as a strong contributor, and is ready to own that kind of architecture for the first time, with direct partnership from the GM on the highest-stakes tradeoffs.

What You'll Do

1. Overall Software Architecture

  • Design the software architecture that ties the products data flow, processing, and user-facing product together end to end.

  • Define clean interfaces with the sensor integration and API work, so the pieces fit into a coherent whole rather than a collection of one-offs.

  • Make and document the core architecture decisions early, since the system needs to flex as we learn what the product needs to become.

2. Data Handling & Pipeline

  • Architect the edge vs. cloud processing split — what runs on-system under power/compute constraints versus what gets backhauled.

  • Stand up time-series and object storage systems for sensor and telemetry data, and the ingestion pipeline that gets data from the system to backend reliable.

  • Design for bandwidth-constrained, compression-aware data transport, and build in the data versioning and observability needed to trust what's flowing in as sensor types multiply.

3. Detection, Classification & Pattern-of-life

  • Work with various sensor modalities, including acoustic, EO/IR, radar, RF/AIS, and others, to build detection and classification capability — starting with classical signal-processing methods where appropriate, and applied ML where it earns its complexity.

  • Contribute to pattern-of-life anomaly detection work.

  • Fuse multi-modal signals into a single detection/classification output.

4. User Interface — Configuration & Visualization

  • Build the product configuration interface and the geospatial data visualization layer (the common operating picture) the end customer will actually use.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Architecture contribution, ready to lead: you've been part of a small team that designed and built a system with real architectural stakes — edge/embedded software, sensor or data pipelines, or similar — and you're ready to own that kind of system yourself for the first time.

  • Data pipeline and storage experience: comfortable designing and operating time-series data systems and message-based ingestion pipelines (MQTT, Kafka, or equivalent), including handling for intermittent/unreliable connectivity.

  • Full-stack range: comfortable moving between backend/data pipeline work (Python, Go, or similar) and frontend (React/TypeScript) without needing a specialist for each; enough familiarity with embedded/edge constraints to architect around them, even if you're not writing firmware yourself.

  • At least one sensing/signal domain: hands-on experience with at least one of acoustic, EO/IR, or radar signal processing or detection — and genuine excitement to pick up the others as the product grows into them.

  • Cloud infrastructure ownership: able to stand up and maintain CI/CD and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GovCloud experience a plus) without a dedicated DevOps function yet in place.

  • Step-up temperament: proven ability to build and rebuild quickly with loose specs, and comfort taking ownership of a decision you'd previously have brought to someone else.

Strongly Preferred

  • TAK (or similar government system) integration experience: hands-on work integrating with TAK (ATAK/WinTAK/TAK Server) or a comparable government C2/situational-awareness system is a significant plus.

  • Applied ML experience, particularly anomaly detection or pattern-of-life modeling.

  • Prior experience in defense or dual-use tech, including familiarity with the general shape of DoD software requirements (security, data handling, eventual ATO/RMF processes).

  • Geospatial visualization experience (Mapbox, Cesium, deck.gl, or similar).

  • Prior experience on an autonomous systems, robotics, or maritime/subsea platform.

What Valinor Offers

  • Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401K, development stipends, among others.

  • Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.

  • We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.

  • Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

This role requires the candidate be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Active clearance preferred, but not required.

Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Valinor team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals, who together are disrupting industry norms by creating new paths towards the future of defense and government technology. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. If you are someone passionate about working on problems that have a real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you!

About the Role

Updater is seeking a strategic, commercially minded Vice President of Marketing to lead our next stage of growth across enterprise platform marketing and large-scale consumer acquisition.

This is a senior leadership role overseeing product marketing, go-to-market, performance marketing, brand, user engagement, and marketing operations. You'll shape how enterprise customers understand and adopt Updater's technology while driving consumer acquisition programs that convert demand into orders.

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you'll lead an established, high-performing marketing team and oversee significant marketing investments. You'll work closely with our current VP of Marketing during the leadership transition, building on a strong foundation to elevate our market position, accelerate growth, and deliver meaningful business results.

Key Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

  • Turn our products and technology into compelling stories, clear value propositions, and effective sales strategies.

  • Partner with Product to bring new offerings to market, drive adoption, and identify growth opportunities.

  • Drive marketing strategies that contribute to pipeline, bookings, customer growth, and retention.

Performance Marketing

  • Lead performance marketing strategy across paid acquisition, digital channels, and conversion optimization, managing eight-figure annual marketing budgets.

  • Optimize acquisition economics, conversion rates, and return on marketing investment to drive efficient, sustainable growth.

  • Identify and test new channels, strategies, and opportunities to increase consumer acquisition and orders.

Brand & Market Leadership

  • Shape how Updater shows up in the market, building a clear, differentiated brand and establishing our leadership in the commerce industry.

  • Lead corporate communications, thought leadership, brand strategy, and PR to grow awareness, credibility, and market presence.

Team Leadership & Marketing Excellence

  • Lead and elevate an established, high-performing team, fostering creativity, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Set clear priorities and oversee marketing operations, resources, and performance to maximize the team’s impact.

Requirements

  • A strategic platform marketing executive. You’ve led marketing at a sophisticated SaaS, marketplace, or technology platform business and know how to position complex products, build market credibility, and drive enterprise sales.

  • A product marketer at heart. You understand how to connect product strategy, customer needs, and go-to-market execution to create compelling value propositions and help the company move faster.

  • A performance-driven growth leader. You have deep experience with paid acquisition, conversion optimization, customer acquisition economics, and managing significant marketing investments. You’re as comfortable discussing CAC and ROAS as you are with positioning and brand strategy.

  • A commercially minded business partner. You understand how marketing drives pipeline, orders, and revenue, and you make decisions based on measurable business impact.

  • A proven people leader. You’ve led talented, multidisciplinary teams and know how to elevate an already strong group.

  • A creative, hands-on thinker. You can set an ambitious vision, challenge conventional thinking, and get into the details when it matters.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $240,000 - $270,000 annually. Factors that may affect compensation within this range include skills, experience, and other qualifications aligned with Updater's internal leveling guidelines.

About Updater

Updater is a leading technology platform helping major brands acquire and retain customers at scale. We are on a mission to power millions of complex transactions through intelligent, autonomous systems. By combining deep integrations, real-world data, and purpose-built AI agents, we’re transforming fragmented purchasing workflows into seamless, automated experiences – freeing businesses and consumers from operational friction and enabling a new standard of speed, accuracy, and scale.

Updater has raised over $450 million from leading investors, including SoftBank Capital, Vista Credit Partners, IA Ventures, Commerce Ventures, Second Century Ventures (the strategic investment arm of the National Association of Realtors®), and more. For more information, please visit www.updater.com.

Updater is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants regardless of color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, actual or presumed belonging to an ethnic group, or any other legally protected status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for full-time positions, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • 13 paid company holidays annually
  • Updater Stock Options
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Wellbeing Subsidy
  • One Medical membership
  • Virtual on-demand healthcare through Teladoc and Talkspace
  • Flexible spending account (FSA)
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • Supplemental Short & Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
