jobs.jobDescription:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the General Manager for Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology (CMET) at Toptal, you will be the visionary architect of our growth strategy in this dynamic industry. We’re seeking a hands-on leader with an entrepreneurial spirit who can inspire and scale a world-class team to drive exponential growth in our enterprise customer base.

In this high-impact role, you will collaborate with Senior Leadership to unlock transformative market opportunities and identify the highest-potential avenues for value creation. Your strategic insight and foresight will be pivotal in shaping the future of Toptal’s presence in the CMET landscape.

You will lead from the front, rolling up your sleeves to work directly with your sales team in forging and nurturing relationships with Fortune 500 companies. Your ability to strategically target and close deals will be integral to our success, positioning Toptal as a leader in the industry.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for driving growth, a knack for crafting compelling strategies, and the ability to execute at the highest level, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Define strategy & execute tactics to acquire key target prospects while deepening strategic relationships with CMET portfolio clients.
  • Cultivate relationships with Senior leaders at accounts in your team’s portfolio.
  • Leverage your professional network connections to expand reach within your industry.
  • Develop hypotheses to drive the team’s Go-to-Market Strategy and expand Toptal’s presence within Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • Develop & prioritize industry-specific offerings in alignment with Category Service Leaders
  • Evaluate and evolve the team’s short-, medium-, and long-term plan to establish Toptal as the leading provider of professional services in the enterprise space.
  • Develop account prioritization criteria and work with members of the team to optimize account portfolios and engagement strategies.
  • Develop account plans and relationship maps by leveraging industry insights.
  • Lead a team of experienced Sales & Client Services professionals to expand Toptal’s professional services market share within the Communication, Media, Entertainment, and Technology industries.
  • Regularly meet with Sales Director & CMET team members to review KPIs, provide guidance to increase deal velocity, evaluate performance, and develop coaching plans.
  • Lead with both inspiration and accountability, establishing clear performance standards, providing direct feedback in real time, and driving execution through focused, consistent coaching.
  • Actively recruit new members to join our rapidly growing team

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Learn our sales method and our selling process.
  • Meet the team and understand targets and goals.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Build your initial GTM strategy for CMET in partnership with Services GMs, iterating based on feedback from clients while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Get up to speed on your industry territory and understand priority focus areas at the portfolio level
  • Develop a performance cadence with the team to review key metrics (e.g., activity, conversion, etc.) and identify specific areas for improvement.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Roll out a focused industry strategy to align the team around clear goals, tactics, and go-to-market priorities across the CMET.
  • Scale growth with existing clients and have a defined strategy to procure high-potential net-new clients.
  • Engage with services stakeholders to develop coordinated strategies designed to accelerate and diversify growth while strengthening client relationships.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Secure initial traction within the CMET sector by closing new enterprise logos and expanding opportunities with existing clients, laying the groundwork for accelerated growth.
  • Assess current team structure and capabilities, making necessary changes to ensure the right team is in place to support near-term opportunity and long-term growth goals.
  • Establish clear team and individual performance objectives, aligning efforts around pipeline generation, sales velocity, and account development to drive early momentum.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual growth objectives by setting clear performance expectations across the team, leading business reviews, and coaching through deal cycles.
  • Demonstrate your ability to coach and develop the team to achieve ambitious goals while continuously improving pipeline health, close rates, and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Expand the team’s portfolio by securing five or more new Fortune 500 clients, deepen relationships with existing clients, and promote growth through Toptal’s suite of offerings.
  • Partner with Toptal Leadership to design and operationalize a 12-month growth plan for CMET through focused industry segmentation, strategic account targeting, and effective resource alignment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in Professional Services, including 5+ years leading sales teams in Communication, Media, Entertainment, & Technology.
  • 5+ years of in-market experience running and managing an industry business unit. Must have current, deep industry relationships at the leadership level within CMET.
  • Experience establishing high-impact, revenue-generating commercial relationships, with a proven track record of success in building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Minimum of 10 years experience building client portfolios of $20M+ with a blended team of hunters and farmers
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and the ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Recent experience selling large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • P&L experience with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Skilled at fostering positive internal relationships to align stakeholders, build consensus, and drive forward key strategic initiatives.
  • Experience at a technology or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an operationally rigorous environment with competing deadlines and fast-paced work product turnaround.
  • Ability to thrive and excel in a dynamic, fast-paced organization.
  • Professional maturity, solid EQ skills, and executive presence – you’re an adept storyteller with experience building long-term client relationships and influencing senior-level buyers.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to travel and engage with Toptal clients both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Oversight - Processing with deep mortgage operations experience and strong independent judgment. This is not a traditional customer support or relationship-only role. You will act as a senior operational partner to our originating customers, owning issue resolution end-to-end and ensuring loans move cleanly, compliantly, and predictably through the lifecycle.

You will work directly with customers while collaborating closely with underwriting, processing, product, and engineering to reduce errors, prevent rework, and improve system-driven workflows. This role is ideal for someone who has worked inside the loan file, understands where mortgages break, and is motivated to help build scalable, automated systems that eliminate those failures over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about operating with rigor today while helping design the future of automated mortgage infrastructure, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Origination Ownership

  • Act as a operational point of contact for originating customers, owning issue resolution from identification through closure

  • Guide customers through the full loan lifecycle, providing clear, accurate direction on requirements, timelines, disclosures and next steps

  • Own the operational health of assigned loans end-to-end, ensuring files progress on schedule and close on time by proactively identifying blockers, driving resolution, and coordinating across internal teams and customers.

  • Proactively manage customer expectations to reduce inbound escalations and uncertainty

Operational Judgment & Risk Prevention

  • Independently evaluate loan scenarios to identify potential structural, disclosure, or compliance risks before they escalate

  • Catch missing, inconsistent, or incorrect inputs that could lead to redisclosures, delays, or downstream rework

  • Provide firm, professional guidance to customers when corrections or process adherence are required

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with underwriting, processing, and closing teams to ensure clean handoffs and aligned execution

  • Serve as a trusted escalation point, reducing leadership involvement by resolving complex or high-stakes issues directly

  • Coordinate with third-party vendors to ensure issues are addressed efficiently, quickly and accurately

Systems & Product Feedback

  • Identify recurring patterns, edge cases, and workflow gaps that impact loan quality or customer experience

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to help define requirements, guardrails, and operational acceptance criteria

  • Contribute real-world mortgage insight to improve automation, tooling, and system-driven decisioning

Documentation & Quality

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation of customer interactions, decisions, and follow-ups

  • Ensure customer-facing communication aligns with regulatory requirements, internal standards, and operational best practices

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of mortgage industry experience, with hands-on roles in processing, underwriting, or a similar operational function

  • Direct experience working loans from application through CTC and closing

  • Hands-on experience with mortgage disclosures, including preparing, reviewing, or validating LEs and CDs, with a strong working knowledge of TRID timing, tolerance categories, and re-disclosure triggers.

  • Ability to independently sanity-check loan structure, including LTV, product eligibility, and basic compliance considerations

  • Prior experience serving as an escalation point for brokers, borrowers, or loan officers

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where processes are still being built

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mortgage concepts clearly and confidently

  • High attention to detail paired with strong problem-solving instincts and sound judgment

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a call-center or script-based customer support role

  • This is not a traditional CSM focused only on relationship management

  • This is not a sales or loan officer role — there are no commissions or volume-based incentives

  • This role requires independent mortgage judgment, ownership, and accountability

Benefits

Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon
Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents
401(k): Ability to save for your future
Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off
Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace
Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world
At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready

jobs.jobDescription:
Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager who knows the difference between content that's worth someone's time and content that just fills a page.

A content creator with a perspective that goes beyond what AI can generate, strong writing skills, a feel for what resonates with people, and a sharp editorial instinct.

You'll own Influ2's content strategy and execution across channels, from website and blog content to thought leadership and email marketing.

You'll work closely with every marketing function, especially SEO, to make sure our content is both genuinely good and effective.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys shaping the direction and doing the work.

What you'll do:

  • Content strategy: Own our content strategy and editorial calendar. Identify the topics, stories, and formats worth investing in, and connect content priorities to our goals.
  • Content creation: Write, edit, and produce content across our website, blog, thought leadership, customer stories, reports, and other formats.
  • SEO and GEO growth: Partner closely with SEO to create content that earns visibility without sacrificing quality.
  • Email marketing content: Own the content and copy for email marketing, including newsletter, nurture sequences, campaign emails, and customer comms.
  • Content distribution: Work with channel owners to find opportunities to extend the life and impact of strong content.
  • Editorial quality: Set and maintain a high editorial standard across everything we publish, making sure our content is clear, distinctive, and worth someone's attention.

What success looks like: Influ2 produces content that people recognize, remember, and want to engage with, and that impact shows up in the pipeline. Marketing teams see you as a creative and strategic partner who brings strong ideas.

Your experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing or editorial roles, preferably within B2B technology or SaaS. Experience in martech, adtech, or ABM is a strong plus.
  • A strong portfolio of content you've personally written that shows original thinking, excellent writing, and the ability to work across formats.
  • Experience owning content strategy and execution, from developing ideas to production and performance analysis that informs editorial and strategic decisions.

Your skills:

  • You have strong editorial instincts. You can recognize a great idea, spot a boring one, and explain what would make it better.
  • You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated topics feel simple without stripping away what makes them valuable.
  • You have a point of view. You follow what's happening in marketing and technology, question familiar approaches, and come up with ideas that aren't obvious.
  • You're curious about customers, their challenges, and how they make decisions. You know how to find useful insights through conversations, research, and data.
  • You can move between big-picture thinking and hands-on execution.

At Influ2, we highly appreciate a wide range of experiences and backgrounds. So, even if your history doesn't perfectly match our list, we would still be delighted to receive your application and learn more about you!

What's in it for you?

  • Have a direct impact on how Influ2 tells its story and builds its voice in the market.
  • Own content across the business, with room to experiment, introduce new formats, and bring your own ideas to life.
  • Remote work flexibility with no fixed working hours; work where and when it suits you.
  • Unlimited vacation policy to support a healthy work-life balance.
  • Generous parental leave and other well-structured PTO policies.
  • A well-rounded health package with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

We're convinced that the diverse ideas and experiences every Influ2encer brings are the key to our success. To make sure our culture and products reflect this blend of viewpoints and backgrounds, there's no room for discrimination here. Our approach to hiring, training, promoting, and compensating individuals is grounded in merit and competence.

We're committed to offering equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, no matter their race, age, religion, where they come from, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Everyone at Influ2 plays a part in keeping our workplace welcoming and free from discrimination and harassment.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Second Dinner is an award-winning independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. In fact, our game MARVEL SNAP has earned multiple Mobile Game of the Year Awards (Game Awards, DICE), Best Strategy Game (IGN), and the Apple Design Award for Innovation!

Second Dinner is a remote-first studio, so while we are headquartered in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote across the United States. We want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. A diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company and will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside.

Our Engineering Team:

At Second Dinner, we believe that great people in a great work environment lead to great games and player experiences. In engineering, we empower our teams to build and innovate with best-in-class tools in novel ways. Our goal is to simplify game development and redefine what is possible in game development.

Your Role:

You will own and drive Marvel Snap’s Test Automation initiative, as well as perform various DevOps duties. You will report to the Lead Engineer of the Live Stability team and collaborate with QA analysts, engineers, and artists to create test suites, build pipelines, and develop tools to ensure we deliver the highest quality games possible to our players! If you’re passionate about testing, automation, validation, and continuous integration, then we'd love to hear from you!

This is a 6-month contract role to start (with possible extension), but if it's a great mutual fit, it could evolve into a full-time position.

What You’ll Do:

  • As an automation superhero, you’ll identify, design, and deliver technical solutions (frameworks, tests, API hooks, tools) that increase test effectiveness, coverage, and overall development velocity

  • Build and enhance continuous integration and delivery pipelines to support development teams across MARVEL SNAP

  • Own the long-term development and roadmap of test automation

  • Implement metrics, analyze test data to identify patterns, and report on risk status to help enhance software quality

  • Optimize testing efforts and develop new opportunities using automation that will empower the QA team to be more effective and efficient

  • Automate everything: from command lines to complex workflows, find opportunities to improve how we build and test the game, ultimately to improve the player experience

What You’ll Need:

  • Demonstrated ability designing and owning scalable automated testing solutions, including test frameworks, test infrastructure, and execution pipelines

  • Proficiency in unit and integration test frameworks in C#/.NET or other object-oriented programming language

  • Experience integrating test pipelines into CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins

  • Knowledge of industry best testing practices, including unit, integration, end-to-end, acceptance, functional, and performance testing

  • Ability to work independently, charting the course for the company in test automation

  • Passion for empowering teams with best-in-class automated testing tools, frameworks, and test harnesses to improve operations

  • An agile mindset, a desire for constant improvement of tooling, automation, and process to improve the quality of our products and the lives of our teammates

  • High levels of empathy and support for team members, both technical and non-technical

  • Passion for playing and making great games

Nice to Have, But Not Necessary:

You must be legally authorized to work and reside in the United States. We do not sponsor visas or support employment outside the U.S. for this role.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Company

Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want.

As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment.

Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives!

The Role

Medely helps healthcare facilities find the clinicians they need to provide consistent, high-quality patient care. As an Associate Customer Success Manager (Scale), you’ll help outpatient and post-acute facilities across the country get lasting value from our platform.

You’ll manage a high-volume portfolio and use customer insights, thoughtful outreach, and scalable programs to strengthen engagement and retention. You’ll help customers overcome common challenges, reconnect with the platform, and make the most of Medely’s tools. Along the way, you’ll help us spot emerging needs and improve how we support customers at scale.

This is an opportunity to build your Customer Success skills while making a meaningful contribution to a team using technology to address real healthcare staffing challenges.

The Impact You’ll Make:

  • Help customers stay engaged: Monitor account activity and health signals, then reach out with relevant guidance when a customer needs support or could benefit from renewed engagement.

  • Make customer education easy to access: Help create and deliver useful communications, webinars, resources, and automated programs that show customers how to get more from Medely.

  • Support retention and growth: Recognize signs of risk or changing staffing needs, take action where you can, and connect customers with the right internal partners.

  • Bring customer needs back to the team: Identify recurring questions and platform challenges, and share clear feedback with Product and other teams.

  • Learn from the results: Track engagement, account health, and campaign performance to understand what’s working and help improve our approach.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll help customers remain active and engaged, contribute to retention and re-engagement, and make it easier for facilities to get value from Medely. You’ll also help the team recognize at-risk accounts, surface growth opportunities, and build more effective ways to support customers at scale.

What You'll Bring

  • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Support, or another customer-facing or operations role.

  • A genuine interest in helping customers solve problems and get more value from a product or service.

  • Comfort reviewing data, spotting patterns, and using what you learn to prioritize your work.

  • Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills - helping customers get more value from Medely.

  • Strong organization and follow-through across multiple accounts and priorities.

  • Curiosity about technology and the ability to learn tools such as Salesforce, Intercom, or similar customer and CRM platforms.

  • A collaborative approach and good judgment about when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring in a partner.

  • The flexibility to balance consistent programs with customer needs that require individual attention.

Compensation: $84,000- $93,000 OTE (base + commission at plan).

Why Medely: Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance

  • Long-term Incentives: 401k

  • Healthcare Benefits: Full suite of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Flexibility: We believe that work/life balance is important, so we offer flexible and unlimited PTO

  • Paid parental leave

  • Purpose: Join a growing mission-oriented startup that is modernizing the healthcare industry nationally!

  • Ownership: Drive meaningful business impact on a team you’ll help build and define!

  • Remote: Work in a digital environment with all the tools to achieve your work as though you were in the office!

We're an equal opportunity employer to all. We interview and hire applicants of all backgrounds, orientations, expressions, and identities.

Work location is flexible if approved by Medely.

Medely does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We consider any resume (CV) or biography received from an agency or outside recruiter without prior approval from a member of the Medely Human Resources or Recruiting team to be unsolicited and gratuitous, and such submissions will not be recognized by Medely for purposes of “ownership” of the candidate.

We are an E-Verify company.

A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. Description

Fleetio is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Developer Enablement team. The Developer Enablement team owns Fleetio’s public API, webhooks, Developer Portal, and the tools that let customers and partners build on Fleetio. You will be a key player in making our API reliable, well-documented, and easy to build on, so that customers and integration partners can connect, extend, and automate Fleetio on their own.

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to drive meaningful impact, excel in problem-solving, and possess a keen eye for developer experience, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of fleet management software.

More About Our Team and Company

  • Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture
  • Engineering culture, interview process and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering

This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate for this role will demonstrate a strong proficiency in backend development and API design, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions. You are passionate about building APIs and developer tools with clean, consistent design and scalable architecture. You should be an effective communicator and be comfortable working in an asynchronous environment with your team. You are product-minded and team-oriented, willing to hear others' opinions and educate on best practices.

Your Impact

  • You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to consistently deliver high-quality software.
  • You will take part in planning, designing, and implementing improvements to Fleetio’s public API, webhooks, and Developer Portal.
  • You will engage in collaborative design and architecture of features.
  • You will deliver well-tested, maintainable, and performant code.
  • You will research and implement prototypes and spikes as necessary to validate assumptions and technical feasibility.
  • You will possess a strong voice in development and planning processes.
  • You will thoroughly review your peers’ code to ensure quality and consistency and to share knowledge.
  • You will set and uphold API standards, and guide engineers across Fleetio as they design and review changes to our public API.
  • You will improve the experience of developers who build on Fleetio through clear documentation, examples, sandbox environments, and tooling.
  • You will help prepare our API for AI-driven use, so that AI assistants and agents can work with Fleetio data safely.
  • You will help customers and integration partners succeed with our API, and take part in the team’s on-call rotation to keep our API, webhooks, and integrations reliable.

Your Experience

  • 5+ years experience with Ruby on Rails
  • 2+ years experience with ReactJS, Typescript
  • Varied experience building full-stack web-based systems and features
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining public REST APIs, including authentication (such as OAuth), versioning, rate limiting, and documentation (such as OpenAPI)
  • Experience with webhooks, event-driven systems, or third-party integrations
  • Previous experience working closely with a product team to architect solutions
  • Strong attention to detail in API design, consistency, and documentation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experienced writing unit, integration, and API tests
  • Experience with developer portals, SDKs, or AI tooling is a plus
  • Be sure to mention “coffee” in your application so we know you actually read this

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options

Description

Our Business Technology team is looking for a Senior Security Operations Engineer to own the security of the tools, devices, identities, and data Fleetians rely on every day. You will help run corporate security operations end to end, covering detection and response, identity, endpoint, email, and SaaS security, data loss prevention, AI security, and vulnerability management, and make the day-to-day security calls that keep Fleetio safe.

You will be hands-on: engineering controls, writing and tuning detections, automating response, and closing gaps, not just administering tools. The goal is one connected defense, not a collection of consoles: a signal from Okta, CrowdStrike, Mimecast, or Google Workspace should drive action in the others automatically, so the environment protects itself and people step in only where judgment is needed. Around-the-clock monitoring is handled by our external SOC (CrowdStrike Falcon Complete); this role engineers the environment it watches, owns what happens when it escalates, and extends what it can see. You will work closely with our IT Operations and Compliance teams, our 3rd party SOC, and the Product Security team in Platform Engineering.

Our team treats AI as a core part of how we work. We build and use AI agents and automated workflows to handle toil, speed up investigation and response, and give our team more time for high-leverage work.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate is a security engineer who likes to build. You are as comfortable writing a detection or a response playbook as you are working an incident. You think in systems: you see the gaps between tools and close them by wiring the tools together. You make sound security decisions on your own, explain them clearly to technical and non-technical people, and balance risk with how people actually work.

You stay calm when something breaks. You can take a vague report, work out quickly what happened and who is affected, and give leaders a clear, evidence-backed answer. Then you fix the root cause so it doesn't happen the same way twice.

You're curious about how AI is changing security operations, and you're eager to put it to work on triage, enrichment, and response.

Your Impact

As a Senior Security Operations Engineer on Fleetio's Business Technology team, you will:

  • Own detection engineering and threat hunting in CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM: onboard log sources, write and tune detections across identity, email, SaaS, and endpoint telemetry, and keep false positives down
  • Own security automation: chain our tools together through CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR and our workflow automation platform so a signal in one (a risky Okta sign-in, a Falcon detection, a Mimecast hit, a Google Workspace sharing change) triggers enrichment, containment, paging, and ticketing in the others, plus AI agents that speed up triage and investigation, so routine response runs without waiting on a human
  • Lead corporate incident response as technical lead, including third-party and supply-chain events: scope exposure quickly, confirm or rule out compromise, run forensics, tell leaders and employees what to do, keep runbooks current with Product Security, and serve in the escalation rotation, backing up the Incident Commander when needed
  • Own CrowdStrike Falcon configuration and detections, manage the Falcon Complete relationship and escalations, and maintain device trust checks and an inventory of software and extensions on company devices with clear guidance on approved tools
  • Own Okta authentication policy, MFA, session policy, and privileged access management, and automate user access reviews and audit evidence with Compliance so SOC 2 controls run with less manual effort
  • Own Mimecast policy, secure network access, Google Workspace and key SaaS security settings, and SaaS security posture in CrowdStrike Falcon Shield, driving findings to closure with app owners
  • Own data loss prevention: define and classify Fleetio's sensitive data, design and tune DLP policies across email (Mimecast), Google Workspace, endpoints (CrowdStrike), and key SaaS apps, and investigate and respond to data exposure, whether from accidental oversharing, a compromised account, or insider misuse
  • Own security for Fleetio's use of AI: visibility into AI tool usage, identity and access for AI agents, guardrails for internal agents and automations, and AI detection and response (CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian, formerly AIDR)
  • Run vulnerability management for corporate assets, prioritizing by exploitability and holding owners to fix deadlines, and report on security posture with clear, honest metrics that help set program priorities

Your Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, detection and response, or security engineering, ideally at a SaaS company
  • Detection engineering and threat hunting in a SIEM (CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM or similar)
  • Security automation: building SOAR playbooks (CrowdStrike Fusion or similar) that connect identity, endpoint, email, and SaaS tools into a single response flow, with Python or PowerShell and REST APIs
  • Incident response from first triage through forensics, root cause, and follow-up across cloud, identity, and SaaS environments, including working with an MDR or managed SOC provider
  • Identity security with Okta or a similar provider: authentication policy, privileged access, and access reviews in a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control environment
  • Endpoint security with CrowdStrike or similar, including macOS, plus device trust and endpoint query tooling
  • Email security (Mimecast or similar) and SaaS security posture management
  • Designing and running a DLP program: data classification, policy design and tuning across email, cloud collaboration, and endpoints, and investigating data exposure
  • Securing developer tooling and the software supply chain (IDE extensions, package registries, AI coding tools)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining risk to non-technical leaders

Considered a Plus

  • Experience securing a company's use of AI: AI tool governance, identity and access for agents, data-exposure and prompt-injection risk, and AI detection and response tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian/AIDR or similar)
  • Experience building AI agents, LLM-powered automations, or integrations (e.g., using tool/function calling or MCP) for security operations workflows
  • Experience using LLMs on real security alerts for triage, enrichment, and investigation

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)

  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend

jobs.jobDescription:
Account Executive

About us…

VLogic Systems is a $12M ARR, private equity-backed SaaS company providing mission-critical Facility Management software across a number of industries including government, healthcare, and education. We are dedicated to helping our customers streamline operations, improve efficiencies, and reduce costs. With more than two decades of experience, VLogic prioritizes responsive support and modular solutions that evolve with changing workplace needs.

We’re a dynamic, collaborative, fully remote team and we’re always excited to speak with candidates who want to have a meaningful impact on our growth.

What you’ll do…

As an Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for driving revenue by identifying prospects, managing the sales cycle, and closing deals while building strong customer relationships that support long-term growth.

Your key responsibilities will include:

● Developing and executing territory and account strategies to achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.Managing the full sales cycle from discovery to close

● Prospecting, qualifying, and closing new business opportunities

● Building trusted relationships with facilities directors, operations leaders, IT executives, procurement professionals, and other key decision-makers

● Managing the RFP/RFI process, working with other teams as necessary to deliver competitive, compliant proposals

● Partnering with Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, product demonstrations, proof-of-concept engagements, and solution presentations

● Maintaining an accurate sales pipeline and revenue forecast using Hubspot

● Working closely with Customer Success, Marketing, Product Management, and Implementation teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and identify opportunities for account growth.

● Consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas

What we’re looking for…

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a high-growth and team-oriented environment. We don’t expect you to check every box, but the ideal candidate will have:

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

· 5+ years of successful B2B SaaS sales experience, preferably selling enterprise software.

· Experience selling CMMS, EAM, IWMS, facilities management, asset management, workplace, or space management software is a plus.

· Demonstrated success managing complex, consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience forecasting and managing pipeline

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiarity with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)

Benefits and Perks…

● 🌎 A remote-first environment - we have employees across the US, and provide all work equipment, a monthly internet stipend, and a one-time stipend to help you set up your home office

● 🩺 Generous healthcare coverage for you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and short- and long-term disability coverage.

● 🏝️ Flexible time off - we offer 10 paid holidays annually and have an unlimited PTO policy, so no need to worry about accruals!

● 📈 401k matching - VLogic provides up to 4% 401k matching on employee contributions to help you invest in your future.

● 🥗 Annual Wellness Benefits, which can be used towards gym memberships, fitness classes, workout equipment, etc.

● 🐾 “Furternity” Leave - we understand that pets are an important part of our employee’s lives. Personal time can be used to adopt or care for a furry friend.

Our Culture

At VLogic, we’re building more than a product - we’re building a team where people can do their best work and be a part of our shared success. Here are some the values that guide us day-to-day:

● Mindful Collaboration: We value thoughtful honesty, treating each other with respect, and embracing both victories and failures

● Creative Problem-Solving: We believe that for every problem, there is a solution, especially with great teamwork, out-of-the-box ideas, and imaginative thinking!

● Ambitious Success: We challenge ourselves as a growing organization to excel by setting goals, prioritizing accountability, and recognizing results.

● Ownership: Everyone at VLogic is empowered to take initiative, make decisions, and drive outcomes. We hold ourselves accountable for results.

● Growth Mindset: We’re always looking for ways to improve and grow. We have an open culture and a leadership team that values communication and feedback.

If you like what you hear, we’d love to talk!

Compensation: $95-105k base salary with $150-165k target OTE. Salary ranges are determined by location, level, experience, and skills. This will be discussed further with the Talent team during the interview process.

At VLogic we believe that a diverse workforce leads to better outcomes, broader perspectives, and a stronger team. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability during the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@vlogicsystems.com.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Partnerships Team

The Partnerships team sources, negotiates, and manages external relationships behind DuckDuckGo's products, from AI model and cloud infrastructure providers to distribution, content, and monetization partners. Alongside that work, the team also handles a steady stream of vendor deals for the software, tooling, and service contracts that keeps the company running.

Our Need

We are seeking a well-established, independent Procurement Advisor Practice to advise the partnerships team in DuckDuckGo's vendor selection, procurement and negotiations. Our procurement efforts cover a broad set of vendors including collaboration tools, AI services, SaaS, analytics and data tools, developer tooling, and professional services. We are seeking a procurement advisory practice that will provide our team with counsel on needs scoping, vendor identification, vendor conversations, price negotiations strategies and benchmarks, and guidance on proposed terms. DuckDuckGo remains responsible for our internal processes and approvals, and for signing vendor contracts.

Advisory Practice Profile

  • 10+ years advisory practice in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with a focus on software and SaaS. Your practice has provided direction on hundreds of contracts and has deep enough experience to provide clients with guidance on where the leverage usually is.

  • Your practice has a well-established approach to commercial and contractual details -- including deep experience in providing guidance on order forms, MSAs, and DPAs terms, a time-tested methodology for vendor comparison, and proven track record of working across a client organization including with legal, security, finance, product, engineering.

  • Your practice has sufficient capacity to advise many small deals in parallel, each with a different internal owner.

  • Your practice has deep experience in providing deal advisory across a broad set of vendors: collaboration, recruiting, analytics, developer tooling, data and research subscriptions, professional services.

  • Your practice has a proven track record of building trust quickly with client teams, providing clear client communications, and working asynchronously across multiple time zones in North America and Europe.

  • Your practice cares about privacy and has experience in navigating data handling and security issues with clients and vendors.

  • Your practice is an established business: an operating entity or registered sole proprietorship with other current clients, its own professional liability insurance, and client references available on request.

  • Your practice is located in the US.

Engagement Details

We expect the scope of work to cover an estimated 3 to 5 deals per month (estimated approximately 15-20 hours per week) compensated by a fixed rate, with pricing for additional volume set out in the statement of work, starting with an initial six-month term with the option to extend. This is a business-to-business services engagement, not employment. Your practice will deliver advisory services remotely on its own schedule with working sessions scheduled by mutual agreement. Your practice will use its own equipment, tools, and methods. DuckDuckGo will provide the deal information and access to internal deal owners needed for each engagement, and limited system access where a specific deal requires it.

As an independent consultant, your practice is responsible for its own taxes, insurance, and business expenses, and invoices DuckDuckGo monthly under the statement of work.

How to Submit a Proposal

Please send a short proposal to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com with the subject line of “Procurement Advisory Services“ covering your practice's background and structure, representative clients and references, your proposed approach and the personnel who would perform the work, and your fee proposal for the scope above.

Nondiscrimination Policy

DuckDuckGo evaluates proposals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our selection process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the proposal process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to bdhiring@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

Please note that:

  • Your practice will be subject to DuckDuckGo's standard vendor due diligence, including privacy and security review, and must confirm that any personnel assigned to the engagement have passed a background check conducted by your practice.

  • By submitting a proposal, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information is cause for rejection of the proposal or immediate termination of the engagement.

DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN VENDOR SELECTION

As part of our commitment to enhancing our vendor evaluation process, we use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to help review and summarize proposals, flag potentially fraudulent submissions, and compare proposals against our evaluation criteria. All final selection decisions are made by DuckDuckGo personnel. Information you submit will be handled in accordance with our privacy policies. If you have questions, contact bdhiring@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in working with DuckDuckGo!

jobs.jobDescription:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Sales Mission

We strive to innovate and enhance our customers' ability to communicate within today's digital, cloud and real-time business environment. Our sales team is composed of highly-motivated, energetic and customer-focused Team Members that expand existing accounts/channels and find new clients for company products and services.

Why this role matters

Inbound Sales generates interest and qualifies leads with potential customers. We attract the interest of potential customers by touting the benefits and competitive superiority of Vonage products and services. We engage with customers to understand their interests and needs, working with them to define the right mix of Vonage products and services for their situation. The Inbound Sales Development Representative (Applications: UCaaS & CCaaS) partners with cross-functional teams to develop customer engagement and selling strategies, applies logic and creativity to build customer relationships and works with customers to understand needs and expectations.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW...

What you will do

  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of Vonage Business Cloud products, sales methodology and processes to exceed quota via acquisition of new customers through prospecting and collaboration among cross-functional teams.
  • Support outreach initiatives including email blasts, direct mail and phone.
  • Serve as the customer’s first point of contact, providing product education and collaborating to build the value proposition.
  • Partner with counterparts in Sales, Marketing and product organizations to ensure leads are identified and effectively assessed.
  • Anticipate customer needs and concerns, maintain knowledge of their problems and issues.
  • Educate potential customers on product offerings and services, explaining pricing and answering questions.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed lead, account, contact, opportunity and sales activity records in Salesforce CRM.
  • Consistently meets established monthly contact, lead generation and other measures.
  • Assist with special projects as assigned.

What you will bring

  • Outstanding communication skills, including writing, speaking and listening.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Ability to:
    • Thrive in a fast-paced environment
    • Apply arithmetic concepts on a recurring basis
    • Apply basic computer skills: word processing, spreadsheet, email and database software
    • Understand and apply Salesforce CRM
  • Desire to understand and gain expert knowledge of Vonage products and services.

What is required for application

  • Bachelor's Degree Ideal but not essential
  • Ability to work in dynamic, changing environment with minimal direction
  • Experience in Salesforce CRM preferred
  • Well organized, go-getter mentality, and a pre-planner
  • Natural curiosity, a love for learning

What is in it for you

In addition, to providing exciting work, career advancement opportunities, and a collaborative work environment, Vonage provides competitive pay and benefits including unlimited discretionary time off and tuition reimbursement.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

US Pay Transparency

$45,280—$59,500 USD

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

jobs.jobDescription:
We are a team of engineers that translate our real-world experience to help our user communities solve problems. With a focus on AI-accelerated workflows and next-generation developer ecosystems, you will have the opportunity to meet fast-moving teams where they are, helping them lay strong engineering foundations and broadening your impact to the developer community at large. This is a unique opportunity to use both your engineering depth and authentic storytelling skills to shape how the next wave of builders approach software health, scalability, and observability.


What You’ll Do:

  • Help developers hone their craft in an AI-accelerated world by exploring how AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools change software workflows, and guiding teams on how to balance rapid prototyping with established engineering practices around performance, code health, and system reliability.
  • Build in public by creating authentic, peer-to-peer technical content, sharing your engineering insights directly where modern developers collaborate in person and online.
  • Drive a constructive, bidirectional feedback loop between fast-moving developer communities and our internal teams, translating real-world developer experiences into actionable product insights to shape our roadmap while advocating for user needs from the inside.
  • Design and ship high-quality open-source boilerplate templates, quickstarts, and tools that make integrating observability seamless across AI native workflows, next-gen platforms (Vercel, Supabase, etc.), and cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).


Who You Are:

  • A builder with approximately 10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally having shipped applications from scratch or worked within an early-stage startup environment where you've worn multiple hats.
  • An AI-fluent developer who natively leverages AI coding assistants and rapid-prototyping tools as a core part of your regular, day-to-day development workflow.
  • Multi-stack familiar, comfortable writing and debugging code across multiple programming languages (such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Python) and experienced with deployment paradigms spanning next-gen platforms and traditional cloud ecosystems.
  • An authentic communicator with approximately 3+ years of experience in technical storytelling and community engagement, backed by a publicly available portfolio of peer-to-peer artifacts like GitHub repositories, technical blogs, video walkthroughs, or public speaking presentations.
  • A forward thinker who loves self-driven exploration of emerging technologies, and is deeply passionate about developer education, mentorship, and helping other engineers hone their craft.

Bonus points:

  • Active community presence or leadership: You are an active participant, contributor, or moderator in developer spaces (such as meetups, Discord, Reddit, or open-source ecosystems focused on next-gen tech).

jobs.jobDescription:
Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators - Public Sector

As the Senior Capture Manager, Federal Systems Integrators (FSI), you will lead joint capture and channel coordination across Datadog's federal systems integrator and prime-contractor ecosystem, serving as the connective tissue between those partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams. You will make sure capture activity happening inside FSI partner organizations is visible to, aligned with, and reinforced by Datadog's own federal sellers, and vice versa, so that partner-led and direct-led motions strengthen a pursuit rather than duplicate or collide with it. The role reports to the Channel & Alliances (C&A) organization and works cross-functionally with federal sales, distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft), deal desk, and legal to drive joint capture outcomes on priority federal pursuits.

Travel: Less than 25%

Clearance: An active U.S. government security clearance is preferred but not required. Candidates without an active clearance are encouraged to apply.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the joint-capture strategy and partner alignment for a portfolio of approximately 20 priority federal programs, engaging 12-24 months ahead of RFP release
  • Manage each named program as a distinct capture effort, coordinating dedicated engagement across agency stakeholders, FSI partners, and independent software vendors (ISVs)
  • Identify requirements, shape acquisition strategy, engage agencies, primes, and partners, and position Datadog ahead of procurement
  • Act as the primary liaison between FSI partners and Datadog's internal federal sales teams, ensuring each side knows what the other is doing on a given program
  • Build and maintain a documented capture plan for each named program covering mission, stakeholders, funding, acquisition path, competition, partners, Datadog's position, and next milestone
  • Identify and resolve channel conflict early, surfacing where a partner-led and direct-led pursuit are converging on the same account or contract vehicle and brokering a single aligned approach
  • Partner with distribution (Carahsoft, Vertosoft) to keep pricing, SKU naming, and quoting consistent across contract vehicles, including the GSA Schedule and SEWP (Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement)
  • Coordinate teaming strategy with FSI partners, including how partners team with primes and other systems integrators, and flag most-favored-nation (MFN) or pricing-consistency issues to deal desk before they become customer-facing problems
  • Coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs) and sources-sought responses in partnership with federal sales, solutions engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. This role shapes response strategy and reviews submissions but is not solely responsible for authoring them.
  • Advance qualified pursuits through customer discovery, partner teaming, and architectural inclusion, then transfer qualified pursuits to Account Executives (AEs) and Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) for execution
  • Build durable working relationships with FSI partner capture and Business Development (BD) leads and with Datadog's federal account teams so coordination happens proactively, not only when escalated

Who You Are:

  • 8-10+ years of experience in capture management, channel/alliances, or business development within U.S. federal technology sales, with direct exposure to partner-led (sell-thru) motions through systems integrators or primes
  • Experience specifically bridging channel/alliance partners and internal direct sales teams, ideally in a partner-liaison or joint-capture role rather than a standalone direct capture role
  • Working knowledge of government contract vehicles (GSA Schedule, SEWP) and how pricing, SKUs, and quoting flow through public sector distributors such as Carahsoft and Vertosoft
  • Established relationships with, or experience working alongside, major federal systems integrators and primes
  • Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure, observability, cybersecurity, or DevSecOps concepts, sufficient to represent Datadog's technical category credibly with partners and agencies
  • Confident resolving channel conflict diplomatically, able to align a partner-side team and an internal federal team on a single approach without either side feeling sidelined
  • Able to quickly understand deal structure concepts relevant to multi-partner environments - MFN clauses, teaming agreements, pricing consistency across distributors - and explain them to others verbally and in writing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including translating between partner-facing and internal-facing audiences

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

How Success Is Measured:

This role carries defined leading indicators rather than a direct bookings quota, since captures in this motion typically run 12-24 months before transferring to an AE/PSM for close. Success is measured through capture plan completeness and quality, the rate at which programs advance through discovery, partner teaming, and architectural inclusion, and the portfolio's contribution to qualified sourced pipeline and closed bookings over time. Detailed year-over-year targets are tracked internally as part of the C&A scorecard.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Meaningful ownership of high-value federal programs from early shaping through capture, with direct influence on how Datadog wins in the federal market
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • An inclusive company culture and the opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

This role carries an 85/15 base-to-MBO pay mix, where MBO refers to Management by Objectives. This is not a quota-carrying position; the MBO component is tied to the leading indicators and outcomes described above. Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience across our participant-facing ecosystem: web, native mobile, and our Chrome extension.

You combine sharp interaction and visual craft with systems-level thinking, keeping the experience unified across both platforms. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering in a fast-paced environment powered by AI-augmented workflows.

You default to extreme ownership. You define the product vision, hold the bar for what ships, and identify critical gaps before anyone asks.

This is a wide-scope, fully hands-on IC role focused on driving participant growth. As you get up to speed and evaluate the ecosystem, we expect you to identify where design bottlenecks lie and make the case for how we scale the function over time.

How we work

AI environments like Claude and Cursor are first-class design tools here. We don’t throw static specs over the fence or get bogged down in alignment decks. Instead, we use AI tooling to spin up interactive prototypes and live code early, letting us test real interactions and iterate on actual software.

We operate as curious, low-ego builders who value showing over theorizing. We share unfinished work early, critique often, and solve problems collaboratively across disciplines. You will have a direct hand in shaping both our product ecosystem and the way we build together.

What you'll do

  • Set cross-surface product vision: Define and drive the design direction across mobile, web, and our Chrome extension, ensuring the ecosystem feels intuitive, cohesive, and unified.
  • Act as a core product thought partner: Collaborate across multiple PM work streams to sharpen product strategy, deconstruct complex problems, and find simpler, faster paths to release.
  • Execute hands-on at high velocity: Design core flows, components, and high-fidelity interfaces yourself, leveraging modern AI tooling to maintain quality across a wide footprint.
  • Bridge design and native engineering: Work in lockstep with engineers to navigate platform-specific constraints, inspect implementations, and ensure production releases match the intended design fidelity.
  • Evaluate and evolve design infrastructure: Audit our component libraries and design tokens across all surfaces, establishing a scalable foundation and identifying where future design investments or resources are needed.
  • Drive collaborative product discovery: Partner with Product and Research to uncover participant needs, while independently spotting usability gaps and growth bottlenecks to shape upcoming initiatives.
  • Directly inspect post-launch performance: Pull data, synthesize participant feedback, and query product telemetry directly via AI tools and MCPs to iterate fast on live features without waiting in a reporting queue.

What you bring

  • Senior-level multi-surface craft: Shipped portfolio work showing exceptional visual and interaction design across native mobile, web, and extensions.
  • Design system governance: Proven experience building, maintaining, and governing design systems in direct partnership with engineering, including keeping components, design tokens, and interaction patterns aligned across multiple connected platforms.
  • Strong systems thinking: You naturally look for recurring patterns, reusable frameworks, and structural solutions rather than one-off fixes, without sacrificing visual polish or interaction craft.
  • AI-native daily workflow: Hands-on mastery of modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and production design.
  • High technical fluency: Deep interest in frontend implementation details, component architecture, and the mechanics of how software gets built.
  • Vision plus execution: Comfort operating at 30,000 feet to shape product strategy, then immediately dropping down to design high-fidelity details.
  • Extreme agency & ownership: You identify problems before anyone flags them and own the quality bar from kickoff through release.
  • Comfort with evolving environments: High resilience and autonomy inside a fast-moving team that is actively establishing its operating model.

Nice to have

  • Marketplace experience: Background designing for two-sided marketplaces, dual-sided user journeys, or platform dynamics.
  • Front-end fluency: Practical experience writing code (especially modern React, HTML, and CSS) to build production-grade prototypes or ship interface polish directly.
  • Micro-interaction & motion craft: Hands-on experience with motion design (e.g., Rive, Lottie, or code-based transitions) to bring nuance, feedback, and personality to interface states.
  • Mentorship & leadership instincts: Experience mentoring other designers, leading design crits, or helping scale a small design function.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager, Accounts Payable to lead Accounts Payable and Expense operations. This role will manage individual contributors and may oversee team leads while ensuring invoices, payments, reconciliations, tax reporting, and employee expenses are processed accurately and on time.

The Manager, Accounts Payable will own team performance and execution while driving process improvements, automation, and reporting. You will work across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and other teams to resolve complex issues, strengthen controls, and improve the procure-to-pay experience.

The ideal candidate is a reliable people leader who uses business context and data to make decisions, advises stakeholders, and delivers measurable operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop AP and Expense team members.
  • Manage team performance, staffing, workload allocation, and day-to-day execution.
  • Build a high-performing team with clear expectations, strong accountability, and consistent results.
  • Oversee invoice processing, purchase order matching, coding, approvals, payments, vendor inquiries, and employee expense operations.
  • Ensure AP and Expense activities are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies and controls.
  • Own balance sheet reconciliations, AP close activities, accrual support, aging reviews, and related reporting.
  • Lead annual 1099 reporting and support other AP-related tax and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the primary AP contact for internal and external audits, ensuring requested documentation is accurate and complete.
  • Monitor unmatched invoices, open purchase orders, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, credits, and other outstanding items.
  • Identify inefficiencies across AP and Expenses and lead process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability;
  • Drive automation and AI initiatives related to invoice processing, matching, approvals, reconciliations, exception handling, and reporting.
  • Develop reporting and insights using tools such as Zip, Ramp, Tableau, ERP systems, and other operational data sources.
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics, including processing volume, aging, cycle times, exception rates, and on-time payments.
  • Partner across Procurement, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Finance, and business teams and lead cross-functional initiatives when needed.
  • Evaluate complex issues using business context, advise team members and stakeholders, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Escalate risks and issues that could affect costs, controls, service levels, or short-term business goals.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in accounts payable, Expenses, accounting operations, or procure-to-pay, including people-management experience.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage performance, and deliver reliable results.
  • Experience owning and improving an operational area with measurable impact.
  • Strong knowledge of invoice processing, purchase orders, payments, expense management, reconciliations, accruals, and the monthly close.
  • Experience managing 1099 reporting and supporting internal and external audits.
  • Experience using procurement or finance platforms such as Zip, NetSuite, and Ramp.
  • Sound judgment when addressing diverse challenges, applying policies, and escalating financial or operational risks.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and reliability in a high-volume environment.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
