jobs.jobDescription:
About Veriff

Veriff guarantees trust for some of the largest consumer platforms in the world. We're known for identity verification, but that is only where we started. Every verification we run strengthens the Veriff Network, a trust layer that gets smarter with each check. On top of it, we're building a portfolio of products that help platforms know who, and what, they're dealing with at global scale.

The market hasn't caught up with that story yet. We need someone to change that.

The role

You'll lead product marketing at Veriff, and your first mandate is to reposition the company. Today we're seen mainly as an identity verification vendor. We need the market to see the truth: That Veriff is a trust platform behind the world's largest consumer brands. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, and sales enablement across our portfolio.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write much of the work yourself, including positioning docs, launch plans, pitch narratives, and battlecards, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. You'll start with a small team and grow it as our rebuilt sales organization gains traction.

We're looking for someone who will push us. If you have a strong point of view, like to take smart risks, and would rather make a leadership team a little uncomfortable than blend into the category, keep reading.

What you'll do

  • Lead Veriff's repositioning. Define how the company, the Veriff Network, and our portfolio are positioned, and get the leadership team, sales team, and market behind it.
  • Run product launches end to end, making each one strengthen the company story. Work within a structured annual launch cadence and industry event calendar.
  • Equip our sales team to win enterprise deals with pitch narratives, discovery guides, battlecards, and objection handling. Stay close enough to deals to know what's working, and fix what isn't.
  • Build competitive and market intelligence, and turn win/loss insight into sharper positioning and better product strategy.
  • Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap narrative, and with Marketing and Communications on campaigns and external storytelling.
  • Develop our PMM team, and shape when and how it grows.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in product marketing, including time leading the function or a significant part of it, ideally in technical B2B businesses such as AI, SaaS, identity, fraud, payments, security, or API-first companies.
  • A strong point of view, and a track record of acting on it. You've pushed a differentiated positioning through real internal resistance, and you can show what it achieved.
  • Bold but honest. In a business where trust is the product, you make ambitious claims you can prove.
  • Craft. You've personally written positioning for technical products that works for technical and business buyers alike, and you can make a complex trust topic land in one slide.
  • Proven impact on sales outcomes. You've built enablement that measurably moved conversion, win rates, or deal velocity.
  • Technical curiosity. You enjoy understanding how sophisticated AI products actually work, so you can explain them in a way nobody else can.
  • A bias for action. You'd rather write the first draft than wait for direction, and you also enjoy developing the people around you.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, gaming, marketplaces) or developer-led go-to-market motions.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Brazil, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

Compensation:

The base salary for this role is $200,000 - $220,000 per year. Please note that our salary ranges are based on current market data and the offered compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and other factors permitted by law

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include…

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development and Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please take the time to read our Recruitment Privacy Notice, which explains how we collect and process your data for recruitment-related activities in accordance with applicable laws. Please read the information carefully. By submitting the application with the required information, you acknowledge that Veriff processes the information for recruitment purposes. Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process, we may request that you undergo identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Benefits

Salary range:

£14k – £26k

About the team

This role reports to the CRO and works closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product and Legal.

The opportunity

We're hiring a Partnership Manager to turn Veriff's partner ecosystem into a reliable source of qualified leads across EMEA and the US. You'll build trusted relationships with private equity firms, consulting companies, systems integrators and technology companies, so they introduce Veriff to their portfolio companies, clients and customers. This is not a reseller role: partners refer and influence deals, and our Account Executives close them.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a clear path to people management. As the channel program proves out, you'll have the opportunity to hire and lead a partnerships team.

What you'll do

  • Build the ecosystem. Identify, prioritize and sign partners across four groups: PE and VC firms, management and risk consultancies, systems integrators, and complementary technology companies (payments, onboarding, fraud, fintech).
  • Open portfolio doors. Work with PE operating partners and platform teams to introduce Veriff across their fintech, marketplace and digital portfolio companies.
  • Get into client projects. Position Veriff with consultancies and SIs running KYC/AML, digital onboarding and fraud transformation programs, so we're on the shortlist early.
  • Build tech alliances. Set up integrations, joint solutions and co-marketing with technology partners whose customers need identity verification.
  • Generate and qualify leads. Own partner-sourced pipeline: run account mapping, get warm introductions, and hand qualified opportunities to Account Executives.
  • Co-sell where it matters. Join strategic deals to bring partner context and help AEs win.
  • Enable partners. Give partners clear messaging, use cases, referral processes and incentives so they bring Veriff up on their own.
  • Run joint marketing. Plan events, roundtables, webinars and content with partners and Veriff Marketing.
  • Measure and report. Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in Salesforce and present results in monthly and quarterly business reviews.

What you'll achieve in your first 3 months

  • Get to know Veriff's products, customers and sales motion, and agree a partner strategy and prioritized target list across PE and VC firms, consultancies, systems integrators and technology companies with the CRO.
  • Build relationships with an initial group of priority partners in EMEA and the US, and run your first account-mapping sessions to surface warm introductions.
  • Put the foundations in place: a clear referral and hand-off process with Account Executives, and Salesforce tracking for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Have signed partnerships live across the core partner groups, consistently producing qualified opportunities that Account Executives are working.
  • Deliver measurable partner-sourced pipeline, with first deals progressing or closed, and launch at least one technology integration or joint solution.
  • Run the first joint marketing activities with partners and present results in a quarterly business review, with a plan to scale the program.

What you'll bring — essential

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with 5+ years in partnerships, alliances or business development focused on lead generation.
  • A track record of building partner relationships that produced measurable pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Experience working with PE/VC firms, consultancies (Big Four, strategy or risk), systems integrators and technology partners.
  • Knowledge of fintech, payments, regtech or identity, and how buying decisions are made there.
  • Relationship skills to build trust with partners, managing partners and C-level executives.
  • Strong collaboration with Sales, so partner leads are followed up and converted.
  • Ability to work across EMEA and US time zones.

Nice to have

  • An existing network among PE operating partners, consultancies or SIs in EMEA and/or the US.
  • Experience building a partner program from an early stage.
  • Familiarity with API-first products and technology integrations.
  • Experience within the identity ecosystem, including IDV, biometrics and network intelligence.

With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is seeking a skilled installer to join our team. As an Installation Specialist, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of telematics devices within customer vehicles, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. This role offers a unique mix of hands-on technical work, customer interaction, and strategic project management, perfect for those passionate about technology's role in operational improvement.

The person in this role will be required to travel 50-75% of the time annually.

What You'll Do:

  • Installation and Support: Independently or in collaboration with third-party installers, perform installations of Motive's product suite, comprising gateways, AI cameras, and accessories, across various vehicles and assets.
  • Customer Engagement: Conduct on-site customer training, support trials/pilots, manage RMAs, and serve as the Lead onsite presence for strategic customer deployments.
  • Quality Assurance and Improvement: Oversee strategic installation projects, perform on-site quality checks of third-party installers, and audit documentation to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Innovation and Feedback: Collaborate closely with the Motive Field Engineering team, leveraging field experiences to inform product enhancements and innovations.
  • Guidance and Documentation: Create custom installation guides for specialty configurations or unique customer requests, enhancing the installation process and customer satisfaction.
  • Support and Troubleshooting: Provide remote assistance to third-party installers with installation questions or issues.
  • Escalation Handling: Manage the review and resolution of escalated technical issues, ensuring a positive outcome for all stakeholders.

What We're Looking For:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Extensive experience in technical equipment installation, service, and repair, particularly in automotive or related industries.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of vehicle wiring and electrical systems, and proficiency in interpreting technical documentation and wiring diagrams.
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
  • Must be able to lift and move objects up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, such as lifting equipment, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces.
  • Demonstrated expertise in installing IoT devices and aftermarket electronics at scale, preferably in automotive or related industries.
  • Strong technical background, with the ability to independently manage complex installations and troubleshoot diverse equipment.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively training customers and collaborating with internal teams.
  • Flexibility to travel extensively (at least 50% of the time) and adapt to varying project demands and schedules.
  • A commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement, with a passion for leveraging technology to solve real-world problems.
  • Spanish Language proficiency preferred

About the Role:

This role sits at the center of what makes Motive a great place to work: real investment in our people. Whether it's an intern finishing school, a new GTM hire, or a tenured performer moving up the ranks, this role leads the team that makes those career transitions the best possible experience — and turns them into measurable business impact.

As Global Director, Role Readiness, you'll own and scale Motive's longer-form enablement portfolio across GTM (Sales, Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Customer Success): internship, onboarding, bridge programs, and the month two through month six ramp journey. You'll lead a team of 11, including people managers, and be accountable for GTM team member's experience and how fast they reach full productivity.

What You'll Do:

  • Define the metrics that matter most across the portfolio (e.g., time-to-productivity, ramp-to-quota, promotion/bridge success rate) and hold the team to clear targets.
  • Partner with Sales Ops and Sales leadership on attribution models connecting onboarding and ramp programs to pipeline, quota attainment, and retention.
  • Regularly report progress and success metrics to executive leadership, with clear business justification for additional resources when needed.
  • Build and launch a unified internship program from the ground up — one shared framework spanning multiple GTM functions, with standardized intake, a common intern experience, and a capstone-based path to full-time conversion, replacing today's fragmented, function-by-function approach.
  • Iterate on our role-based Onboarding training tracks across GTM roles, tailored to regional, segment-, and role-specific needs within our global curriculum.
  • Own the month-two-through-month-six ramp journey, formalizing a clear, supported path from "onboarded" to "fully productive" through live sessions, self-paced learning, and hands-on practice.
  • Expand and oversee existing bridge programs (e.g., SDR to AE, AE to higher-level AE) that prepare top performers for advanced roles
  • Lead and coach a team of 11, including people managers, building a culture of ownership and follow-through — you ensure priorities cascade from leadership through to execution.
  • Build systems for accountability: clear owners, deadlines, and status visibility across every program.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales Operations, Finance, and Legal to keep training curricula comprehensive, current, and well-resourced.

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years in sales enablement, including scaling onboarding/ramp programs at a fast-growing SaaS company (5,000+ employees preferred); offshore team/BPO management a plus.
  • Genuine passion for new hire onboarding and employee experience — you see career transitions as a lever for culture, retention, and performance.
  • Proven ability to build accountability systems at scale, ensuring priorities cascade from leadership to execution.
  • Experience leading people managers, not just ICs, on a team of similar size.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered enablement tools (e.g., dashboards, roleplay simulators) — a builder, not just an administrator.
  • Fluency in established sales methodologies (e.g., Sandler, Command of the Message, MEDDPICC) and the ability to align them with Motive's proprietary methodology.
  • Experience applying formal measurement frameworks (e.g., the Kirkpatrick Model) to certification and training programs.
  • Strong ability to translate complex ideas into curriculum and how sales professionals learn best.
  • Experience running global enablement programs across diverse markets, segments, and roles.
  • Expert communicator who builds relationships and influences stakeholders at all levels.

Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

San Francisco, California

$239,000—$299,000 USD

U.S. metropolitan areas: New York City Area and Seattle, WA

$229,000—$286,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As Director, Security Compliance and Trust, you will build and lead the function that earns and sustains customer, regulator, and partner confidence in Motive. Reporting to the CISO, you will own governance, risk and compliance; audit and certification across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS and the path to FedRAMP; privacy and data protection; customer trust; security policy; training and human risk; and AI governance. You will partner closely with Legal, Engineering, Product, IT, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to make compliance a business enabler rather than a tax.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a small, senior, globally distributed team — and you will also write policy, design controls, sit in audit fieldwork, and answer the hardest customer questions yourself. We expect this function to be built AI-first, with automation designed into the operating model from day one rather than added to a traditional GRC team later. Global expansion is central to the role: Motive is growing into Canada, the EU, Mexico and South America, and you will be the person who makes those markets enterable — mapping obligations before Sales arrives and building controls that satisfy multiple jurisdictions at once.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the compliance, privacy and trust function end-to-end — org design, hiring, and global team development — and act as Motive's senior authority on the control environment, deciding which frameworks we adopt and where we accept versus remediate risk
  • Build a single integrated control framework that maps once to many across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, so evidence is collected once rather than once per framework or once per country
  • Own the annual audit calendar end-to-end, manage auditor and assessor relationships directly, and lead Motive's path to FedRAMP from the ground up as public sector opportunity matures
  • Own privacy compliance operations — data subject rights, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics — treating driver data as the sensitive category it is, including location history, in-cab video, telematics behavior and biometric-adjacent processing
  • Own regulatory readiness for new markets ahead of go-to-market, partnering with Engineering and Platform on data residency and regional architecture rather than solving localization with policy language
  • Be the face of Motive's security and privacy posture to customers — owning trust.gomotive.com, scaling security questionnaire and review response, and serving as the senior escalation point in enterprise deals
  • Architect the AI-first operating model for the function, personally building and iterating on evidence automation, continuous control monitoring and AI-assisted questionnaire response rather than delegating it to a tooling vendor
  • Own the security policy and standards library and its exceptions process, along with company-wide security training, phishing simulation and human risk measurement
  • Establish Motive's AI governance program across both product and internal AI use, building against ISO/IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the EU AI Act

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in security compliance, GRC, privacy, audit or risk management, including 5+ years in leadership roles managing both people managers and senior individual contributors
  • Demonstrably hands-on. You have personally written the policies, designed the controls, built the control mappings, sat through fieldwork and answered the hardest customer questions yourself — recently, not a decade ago. Be prepared to walk through work you did with your own hands
  • Proven ownership of multi-framework compliance programs at scale in a cloud-native SaaS environment — ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and PCI DSS as core, with the judgment to run them as one program rather than three
  • Deep, operational privacy experience across GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, with hands-on ownership of DSAR operations, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics. CIPP/E, CIPP/US or CIPM is a plus, but demonstrated operational ownership matters more
  • Experience standing up compliance and privacy in new international markets, ideally including Canada, the EU, Mexico or Latin America. Familiarity with PIPEDA/Law 25, LGPD or the Mexican LFPDPPP is a strong advantage
  • Experience with FedRAMP, ideally having led an organization through authorization or Moderate/High readiness, with the appetite to build Motive's path from the ground up
  • Concrete, demonstrated use of AI to run compliance work — evidence collection, questionnaire response, control monitoring, policy drafting, audit preparation or regulatory gap analysis. We will ask what you built, what it replaced, and what it measurably changed. General enthusiasm for AI is not what we're looking for
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer-facing trust functions — security reviews, questionnaires, trust portals and enterprise escalation — and experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple timezones
  • Working fluency in AI governance frameworks and a clear point of view on governing AI without blocking its adoption
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness, SOX or equivalent regulated-environment scrutiny, and experience with sensitive personal data at scale, are both strongly preferred

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive's Customer Engineering team is a post-sales technical solutions function for our largest, most strategic, and business-critical customers. As the Director, Customer Engineering, you'll lead and develop a team of Customer Engineers who turn difficult operational problems into working solutions using Motive's products, supported APIs, data, reporting, and automation.

You'll combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing problem solving to help the team deliver measurable customer value. You'll establish how the team prioritizes engagements, maintain a high bar for solution quality, and ensure successful customer work becomes reusable expertise for Motive's customers and broader Solutions Engineering organization.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you’ll help the team solve meaningful customer problems, validate what works, drive lasting customer value, and ensure clear ownership after handoff.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and develop Customer Engineers, setting clear expectations for technical quality, customer accountability, collaboration, documentation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build a culture of technical curiosity, practical problem solving, thoughtful prioritization, and reusable knowledge.
  • Prioritize strategic customer engagements where solution work can increase realized value, resolve operational gaps, reduce displacement risk, or support broader adoption.
  • Ensure each engagement has a clear business problem, customer sponsor, feasible solution path, success measures, and owner after handoff.
  • Join the most complex customer engagements to guide discovery, solution design, technical validation, stakeholder alignment, and outcome measurement.
  • Define and evolve the team's engagement model, intake process, capacity planning, technical standards, delivery expectations, and handoff practices; establish an operating cadence for reviewing progress, capacity, quality, and outcomes.
  • Measure solutions delivered and adopted, documented customer value, recurring technical barriers removed, reusable solution patterns, customer-backed product insights, and contribution to retention or expansion.
  • Connect customer-validated needs and technical evidence to Product and Engineering, partner with Customer Success, Implementation, Sales, account teams, and presales Solutions Engineering to coordinate ownership, and turn proven solutions into repeatable workflows, guidance, and enablement for the wider field.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience leading and developing customer-facing technical professionals, with a track record of building team capability and maintaining high standards for delivery.
  • Strong Solutions Engineering, technical consulting, post-sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing experience; you understand the difference between demonstrating a solution and delivering one.
  • Credible technical depth in enterprise SaaS, API-based capabilities, data analysis, automation, integrations, advanced product configuration, and troubleshooting product behavior.
  • Experience turning ambiguous customer problems into delivered solutions with clear adoption and measurable business results.
  • Ability to coach practitioners through customer discovery, technical problem solving, stakeholder management, solution validation, and evidence-backed documentation.
  • Strong judgment about priorities, scope, supportability, and talent development.
  • Ability to work directly with customer executives, IT leaders, frontline operators, and account stakeholders while influencing internal Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience establishing operating models, engagement rules, prioritization frameworks, delivery standards, or other mechanisms that help a technical function scale.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to create clarity across Customer Success, Implementation, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering.
  • Fleet management, transportation, safety, telematics, IoT, or other physical-operations industry experience is preferred.

Pay Transparency

jobs.jobDescription:
👋 Welcome to Glide!

At Glide we’re reimagining the banking experience for the modern world. Our embedded fintech platform empowers legacy financial institutions, like community banks and credit unions, to pioneer novel digital experiences for their customers.

You’ll be joining an all-star team with engineering, product, and growth experience from Stripe, Google, and Amazon. We’re looking for a talented Digital Program Manager (DPM) to help us grow our product to hundreds of banks. We’re bringing a new perspective to the decades-old financial world, and we’re hoping you can help us do that!

Your Responsibilities:

  • Run customer implementations from kickoff to go-live, including requirements gathering, implementation calls, User Acceptance Testing meetings, and bug reporting

  • Oversee customer account management, including formal communications of product updates and roadmaps

  • Travel to client sites for project kickoffs, training sessions, and other key project activities

  • Leverage AI tools to streamline and optimize day-to-day responsibilities

  • Analyze customer data to ideate and recommend new features and enhancements

  • Maintain an accurate record of all customer interactions and transactions, reporting and escalating issues as needed

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with existing clients

Need-to-Haves:

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and large-scale software implementation projects

  • Experience working at a financial institution or fintech company

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills

  • Technical understanding of fintech products

  • Experience working with agile engineering and design teams

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Customer-facing experience at an early-stage company

  • Previous experience in a product or customer-facing role at a fintech or FinServ company

  • Experience with data analysis tools such as SQL

  • Familiarity with project management tools, customer success software and CRM systems

  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit

And finally, a brief overview of Glide’s benefits package:

💸 Competitive Compensation:

As this role can be eligible for remote employees, the base salary range is $140,000 - $155,000. This will be determined by previous experience and location. We also offer a generous equity package for joining us at Glide!

❤️ Wellbeing Credits (for US employees)

Besides stellar health, dental, and vision insurance, we offer a $100 monthly health and wellness stipend to help you stay active and healthy!

🥗 Lunch on us (for US employees)

We’re huge foodies, so every member of the Glide team receives a $100 weekly stipend for lunch or groceries. No one goes hungry around here :)

🌴 Unlimited PTO and Sick Days

We trust our team to balance their responsibilities and well-being, so our unlimited PTO and sick day policy empowers everyone to take the time they need without unnecessary red tape.

💼 Hybrid Working Environment

We’re an actively expanding team, and in our Madison Square Park headquarters and are excited to grow an engaging in-office culture—ideally, our NYC-based team members will join us in the office three days a week to help make that vision a reality.

jobs.jobDescription:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.

New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

About this Role:

As a D2L Solutions Engineer, you'll spend every day helping those around you get the most out of D2L products and services. You'll help prospective clients and educators by learning about their unique needs and proposing solutions including D2L products and services to meet those needs. Your passion for teaching and learning makes people want to open up to you, and your expertise in learning technology and how to accomplish nearly anything using the D2L platform makes you a trusted advisor. You're excited to speak to everyone from students and instructors to a CIO, Professors, Vice Chancellors or Chancellors, and your demos and presentations provoke gasps of amazement, if not outright applause. 

How You'll Make an Impact:

  • Become a hands-on expert in the Brightspace platform. You won’t just need theoretical knowledge of how things work, but you will be expected to try things out and make sure they work in practice. You will need to get creative and sometimes approach and re-approach a solution until you find the right fit. 
  • Support the sales process by becoming an expert in D2L products and services, including functionality, usage, architecture, and deployment.
  • Prepare and present persuasive and expertly tailored product demonstrations before a wide variety of audiences and under challenging circumstances. Audiences could be new or seasoned users, executives at a conference table, university faculty in a lecture theatre or HR and L&D professionals piled into stadium seating. Needs could be vague or extremely unique, and timelines to prepare can vary.   
  • Build compelling, value-oriented presentations while partnering with your sales team to prep for such presentations.
  • Conduct needs analysis sessions with prospects to understand their infrastructure, needs and potential customizations they may require.
  • Provide feedback to product management teams regarding use cases and trends in the field. 
  • Create technical documentation and materials as required for your prospects.   
  • Be the conduit through which internal SMEs are contacted and engaged in sales opportunities. 
  • Attend sales presentations, meetings, and conferences as required (travel 25-50%), and be willing to work various hours across North America from PST to EST.  
  • Engaging in proposal writing - review requirements, identify optimal product mix, address gaps and assessing competitive alignment, and culminating in the creation of clear, concise responses
  • Work with Customer Success and Account Management teams to help existing customers understand Brightspace features, supported configurations, product behavior, and available workarounds.
  • Provide focused product demonstrations, feature guidance, and adoption support when customers need more expertise than the Customer Success team can provide.
  • Help customers adopt Brightspace through webinars, office hours, reusable demonstrations, adoption campaigns, and other customer-facing resources.
  • Review requests involving system architecture, integrations, reporting, automation, implementation planning, or technical governance, and redirect clients to the appropriate specialists in Professional Services, Support, or Product.
  • Work with internal teams to prioritize, coordinate, and assign customer adoption and technical support requests as distinct activities from presales responsibilities, such as sales presentations and opportunity support.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • 3+ years' experience as a Brightspace user either as an administrator or an instructor having used the platform extensively.
  • Acumen with Artificial Intelligence tools.
  • Experience in a higher education institution in an edtech role will be advantageous.  
  • Comfort with other learning management systems and other learning platforms that might integrate with the LMS. 
  • Have a deep interest in education and educational technology including familiarity with technology ecosystem and the LMS. 
  • Must be very comfortable with presenting complex education and technology concepts to a variety of stakeholders. 
  • Be highly engaging in person and virtually.  
  • Must have excellent writing and comprehension skills.
  • Be able to work remotely in a professional manner.
  • Attend sales presentations, meetings, and conferences as required (travel 25-50%), and be willing to work various hours across North America from PST to EST.  
  • Experience meeting multiple objectives in an entrepreneurial environment with minimal supervision. 

This position is to fill an existing vacancy.

The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

Base Salary Range

$72,000—$84,000 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop!

Why we're awesome:

At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through #LifeAtD2L:

  • Impactful work transforming the way the world learns
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Learning and Growth opportunities
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $4,000 CAD for continuing education through our SkillsWave Program
  • 2 Paid Days off for SkillsWave-related activities like exams or final assignments
  • Employee wellbeing (Access to mental health services, EFAP program, financial planning and more)
  • Retirement planning
  • 2 Paid Volunteer Days
  • Competitive Benefits Package
  • Home Internet Reimbursements
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Employee Recognition
  • Social Events
  • Dog Friendly Offices Spaces at our HQ in Kitchener, Winnipeg, Vancouver and Melbourne offices.

jobs.jobDescription:
We are seeking an ambitious, high-performing Sales Executive with a passion for women's health and a proven ability to build trusted relationships with physicians. This role requires exceptional business acumen, attention to detail, and a hunter mentality. The ideal candidate will proactively identify and engage prospective physician partners, assess their fit for Monarch's membership model, and confidently guide them through a thoughtful, consultative evaluation process. As a trusted advisor, they will support physicians through an important professional transition while delivering an exceptional experience.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of successful healthcare sales experience, preferably selling to OB/GYNs, women's health specialists, or primary care physicians. They have a proven track record of developing long-term relationships, navigating complex sales cycles, and earning the trust of physician leaders.

Success in this role requires someone who is proactive, entrepreneurial, and willing to accommodate physicians' schedules—including early mornings, evenings, lunch meetings, and after-clinic appointments. They take ownership of their territory, consistently generate new opportunities, and are energized by prospecting, networking, and building lasting partnerships.

This is a remote position with frequent travel throughout the assigned territory and nationally for conferences, physician meetings, and company events. The ideal candidate enjoys representing Monarch in person and serving as a trusted face of the organization.

The successful candidate is an outstanding communicator with a strong work ethic, high integrity, and a collaborative mindset. They thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, adapt quickly to change, and are passionate about advancing women's healthcare by helping independent physicians build stronger, more sustainable practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • 5+ years of successful healthcare sales experience, preferably selling to physicians.

  • Experience calling on OB/GYNs, women's health specialists, or primary care physicians strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated success prospecting, developing, and closing new business.

  • Strong consultative sales skills with the ability to lead physicians through complex business decisions.

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

  • Willingness to travel frequently within territory and nationally for conferences and physician events.

  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency.

  • High level of professionalism, resilience, and integrity.

  • Passion for improving women's healthcare and supporting independent physician practices.

jobs.jobDescription:
Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia, and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby.

I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum with whom I’d spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 back in Product Marketing - bringing all these experiences together to help build a thoughtful, high-impact team.

We’re a growing, tight-knit team - and we’re just getting started 🚀 We work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and every level of leadership, including closely with our CEO Benji. We’re seen as strategic partners, not a service desk. PMM at Ashby means influence, visibility, and ownership - and this role is a chance to get in early on a team with strong internal momentum at a company growing fast.

We value technical curiosity, editorial clarity, and first-principles thinking. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and aim to genuinely help customers understand what our product does and how it can help them. You don’t need a decade in PMM to succeed here - but you do need strong product instincts, clear writing, and a bias for building systems that scale.

We’re looking for a Release Marketer who is excited about owning product releases.

This role is for someone who thrives on the details but understands the bigger picture – someone who can clearly explain how a new feature or product benefits prospects and customers in their daily workflows and approach to talent acquisition. Someone who wants to work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how a feature works, and act as a translator for the front-line teams. That means translating product specs into the materials, messaging, and demos that power our releases. This person should feel excited about selling with value and obsess over customer use cases and how we tell our product story. From crafting one-pagers and recording crisp, clear product videos and walkthroughs, to running our product updates newsletter, to building internal enablement that keeps our whole team informed on what’s changed, you’ll help us tell our differentiated story and keep our launch velocity high.

You’ll work across multiple product lines, so you’ll need to context switch easily. Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle and coordinate across multiple teams are among the most important skills for this role. On any given week, you’ll be keeping several releases moving, each with its own Product Manager.

Because we’ve built deep relationships with a thoughtful, engaged customer base, we’re often co-creating with them - sharing product materials that are actually read, used, and appreciated by people who see us as partners, not just vendors.

This is a great fit for someone who enjoys being in the weeds of technical products, but also has a sharp editorial voice, a strong eye for design, strong product instincts, and loves to always be shipping.

While this role will flex across multiple products, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into eventually owning a full product line. This role is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to flex across PMM and enablement skills, and work on product marketing initiatives that create more leverage for our teams.

Your Background

There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including:

  • A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos

  • An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product

  • A Product-minded builder with a technical background and customer empathy

  • A GTM specialist with a strong lean for product taste

What You’ll Do

Release Products and Features

  • Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines.

  • Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies.

  • Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels.

  • Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials.

  • Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious.

  • Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed.

Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team

  • Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market.

  • Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels.

  • Own initiatives that keep the whole team informed on product changes, including our product updates newsletter to customers.

  • Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work.

You Might Be a Fit If You

  • You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping.

  • You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time.

  • You can switch between products and contexts easily, and pick up a new feature quickly enough to explain it well.

  • You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can.

  • You know how to shape a good demo or walkthrough that tells a story. Not just “click here, then here” but “here’s how this solves your problem.”

  • You are comfortable owning your own copy and collaborating with design teams to produce well-polished assets.

  • You can read a launch plan and immediately hear the voices of Sales and CS in your head “but what about XYZ?”, and you’ve already worked with technical and product teams for the answer.

  • You can follow a playbook but are not afraid to go back to first principles thinking and build something from scratch without much direction.

You Might Not Be a Fit If:

  • You’re drained by the strive for perfection. If a letter is out of place or a font is off by a size point, it won’t bother you.

  • You’re not a natural relationship builder and don’t feel comfortable working across Product and GTM folks.

  • You aren’t the person people go to when they’re trying to understand the complexities of a new product.

  • You find stakeholder and project management more draining than satisfying.

  • You’d rather not weigh in on or be the final call on creative because someone else will catch it (noting you will have design support, but that someone to catch it is you :)

Interview Plan:

  • 30 min with Michelle (Recruiting)

  • 45 min Rosalia (Hiring Manager)

  • 30 min with Harriet (VP of Marketing)

  • Assignment

  • 30 min with Benji (CEO and Co-founder)

  • Final Round Interview (1-1.5 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year stock option exercise window. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with a strong culture of actually taking time off.

  • 12 weeks of fully paid family leave (US).

  • Generous budget for equipment, software, and office setup. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month learning budget, with conferences covered with manager approval.

  • Top-tier health insurance for US employees (100% premium covered).

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview:

*]:pointer-events-auto [content-visibility:auto] supports-[content-visibility:auto]:[contain-intrinsic-size:auto_100lvh] R6Vx5W_threadScrollVars scroll-mb-[calc(var(--scroll-root-safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)+var(--thread-response-height))] scroll-mt-[calc(var(--header-height)+min(200px,max(70px,20svh)))]" data-turn-id="request-WEB:bd295af5-b810-45e7-89d4-f2fed4e836b4-0" data-turn-id-container="request-WEB:bd295af5-b810-45e7-89d4-f2fed4e836b4-0" data-testid="conversation-turn-2" data-scroll-anchor="false" data-turn="assistant">

Search is changing. Enterprise buyers now ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews which Customer Experience AI platforms to evaluate, often before they ever visit a vendor’s website. Your job is to make sure Cresta shows up in those answers, shows up accurately, and turns that visibility into pipeline.

You’ll join Cresta’s Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing and working alongside our Content Marketing Manager on a small team that treats organic search and AI discovery as a core pipeline channel.

You will own day-to-day execution of Cresta’s Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and SEO program. Roughly 70 to 80 percent of your time goes to scaling organic search and AI visibility. The rest goes to growth experiments on new acquisition channels and conversion levers.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the systems that make Cresta’s organic engine work: the AI content workflows, the technical foundation, the measurement, and the testing roadmap. The Content Marketing Manager leads writing; you own how that content gets found, cited, and converted. You will also work with web development, product marketing, demand generation, and revenue operations, and report results straight to marketing leadership.

What you'll do

AEO and organic search

  • Grow Cresta's visibility, citation share, and narrative accuracy across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews through content structure, schema, entity consistency, and third-party mentions.
  • Own our AirOps workflows for content briefs, refreshes, and optimization, and keep improving them so a small team ships more without lowering the bar.
  • Run the content refresh pipeline: spot decaying pages in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, diagnose the cause, and partner with the Content Marketing Manager to brief and ship fixes.
  • Restructure high-impression pages for AI answers: answer-first sections, self-contained answer passages, FAQ and list schema, and clear relationships between products, use cases, and industries.
  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, redirects, canonicalization, and site architecture. Work directly in our Webflow CMS to ship fixes, and partner with web development on larger changes.
  • Build an off-site presence program across review platforms, analyst and industry directories, third-party roundups, partner pages, and communities where answer engines source their information.
  • Make sure every product launch and rename gets organic coverage from day one, working with product marketing on URLs, redirects, schema, and answer content.
  • Turn questions from sales calls, support conversations, community threads, and search data into a prioritized answer backlog written in the buyer's own language.

Growth experimentation

  • Design, launch, and read out experiments on emerging acquisition channels, such as community and Reddit, and on landing page and website conversion from organic traffic.
  • Write a hypothesis and success metric before every test launches, then make a clear call to scale it or kill it.

Measurement and reporting

  • Own measurement across non-branded visibility, organic and AI-referred traffic, AI citations and share of voice, and influenced pipeline.
  • Build dashboards that catch ranking drops, indexing issues, crawl anomalies, and technical regressions before they cost us traffic.
  • Connect search and answer engine visibility to pipeline in HubSpot, and keep measured data and modeled estimates clearly separated.
  • Stay ahead of changes in search and AI discovery, and turn them into a clear point of view and a prioritized roadmap.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You own the content refresh pipeline and AirOps workflows end to end, have shipped your first round of answer-first page rebuilds, and run a recurring AI visibility report that leadership reads.
  • First 6 months: You run the AEO testing roadmap independently, have launched at least two growth experiments outside organic search, and can show which pages and channels are driving pipeline.
  • First 12 months: You are the go-to person for how Cresta shows up in AI answers, and the program you run is a repeatable, measurable growth channel.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you do, please apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. If you are coming from an adjacent team and have been teaching yourself AEO on the side, we want to hear from you.

Minimum requirements

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in SEO, growth marketing, or other organic growth roles, with hands-on ownership of a live website.
  • A track record of growing organic traffic and pipeline or signups, not just rankings.
  • Hands-on experience with AEO or GEO, including how AI assistants retrieve, summarize, and cite content, plus at least one project or test you can walk us through, including self-directed ones.
  • Technical SEO fluency and comfort shipping changes yourself: HTML basics, schema markup, and working inside a CMS.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, and GA4, plus an AI visibility tool such as Ahrefs Brand Radar or Profound.
  • Experience defining metrics, building dashboards, and using data to prioritize work, including reconciling conflicting sources and forming your own conclusion.
  • Clear, precise writing. You can write a brief a writer can execute without a follow-up meeting, and an answer passage an LLM can quote.
  • A high bar for quality and full ownership from idea through implementation and measurement.

Preferred qualifications

  • In-house SEO or growth experience at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion or a technically complex product.
  • Experience with AirOps or building content workflows with LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT.
  • Experience with Webflow, HubSpot, or multi-touch attribution.
  • Experience with crawl and log analysis tools, programmatic pages, or scaled content operations.
  • SQL or Python skills for pulling and analyzing data on your own.
  • Experience running conversion rate or community channel experiments, including Reddit.
  • Exposure to customer experience, customer support, or contact center operations.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000.

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.
